entries.zh: 我们很快就能准备好用机械部件来强化我们的生物躯体了。大脑的处理能力和肢体的强度可以得到提升。问题是谁会从这种强化改造中得到最多好处呢。\n\n§Y次月获得植入体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!
entries.en: We will soon be ready to augment our biological bodies with machine parts. The processing power of the brain and the strength of limbs can be increased. The question is who will benefit the most from such augmentation.\n\n§YPops to receive implants next month§!: §G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!

entries.zh: 我们的心灵和身体将会得到升级。
entries.en: Our minds and bodies will be upgraded.

entries.zh: 我们会努力强化我们自己。
entries.en: We will work to augment ourselves.

entries.zh: 各物种不得拒绝义体化。
entries.en: Species must not be allowed to reject cybernetics.

entries.zh: 一座进行义体植入体安装的建筑。有购物商城，有运营中心，还有机械商店。
entries.en: A building for outfitting cybernetic implants. Part shopping mall, part operating center, and part mechanic shop.

entries.zh: 官方医务部允许公民选择并安装经批准的义体植入体。
entries.en: Government clinics allow citizens to select and install approved cybernetic implants.

entries.zh: 一个满足你所有义体需求的庞大综合体，配有个人数字购物商场和豪华的术后水疗中心。
entries.en: A sprawling complex for all your cybernetic needs, complete with personal digital shoppers and a luxurious, post-surgery spa.

entries.zh: 黑市义体医生可以安装任何类型的植入物，但你付出的代价可能不止是几个能量币。
entries.en: Back-alley cyber docs can install any kind of implant, but it might wind up costing you more than a few credits.

entries.zh: 义体植入体的无尽装配线。资源库、操作中心与加工车间应有尽有。
entries.en: Endless assembly lines for outfitting cybernetic implants. Part resource depot, part operating center, and part machine shop.

entries.zh: 一个超然强化的圣地，信徒们在这里通过神圣的融合而获得重生。
entries.en: A sanctum of transcendent augmentation, where the faithful converge to be reborn through the divine fusion.

entries.zh: 强化师是熟练的技术人员，他们利用义体增强来改变有机形态。
entries.en: Augmentors are skilled technicians who alter the organic form with cybernetic enhancement.

entries.zh: $job_augmentor_plural$负责安装义体植入体，将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与机械融为一体。
entries.en: $job_augmentor_plural$ install cybernetic implants to merge [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine.

entries.zh: $job_augmentor_drone_plural$负责研究并设计义体植入体。
$job_cyberdome_duelist_plural$们在$building_cyberdome$中用最尖端的义体植入体一一进行角逐。
entries.en: $job_cyberdome_duelist_plural$ face off in the $building_cyberdome$, utilizing cutting-edge cybernetic implants.

entries.zh: $job_cyberdome_spectator_plural$享受着$building_cyberdome$中的比赛。通过义体大脑观赛时，即便是在最便宜的坐席也能看到如此盛景，但如果允许神经广播的话则还可以以第一人称感受角斗士的体验。
entries.en: $job_cyberdome_spectator_plural$ enjoy games in the $building_cyberdome$. When witnessed via cyberbrain, even the cheapest seats provide a spectacle, but when neurocasting is enabled it's possible to experience gladiatorial combat in first person.

entries.zh: 该物种仅有勉强能适应义体社会所需的最低限度的植入体。
entries.en: This species has the least amount of implants necessary to function in a cybernetic society.

entries.zh: 该领袖仅有勉强能适应义体社会所需的最低限度的植入体。
entries.en: This leader has the least amount of implants necessary to function in a cybernetic society.

entries.zh: 窃取得来的科研成果已经融入了义体化进程中，带来了一些怨恨。
entries.en: Stolen research results have been incorporated in the cyberization effort, leading to resentment.

entries.zh: 研究经费被分散到了公共关系中。
entries.en: Research funds are diverted into public relations.

entries.zh: 一部出名的电影让大众对政府的计划产生了负面的观点。
entries.en: A popular movie has turned public opinion against the government's plans.

entries.zh: 对异见者的严厉对待激起了不满情绪。
entries.en: Harsh treatment of dissidents has fostered discontent.

entries.zh: 禁止某部受欢迎的剧集引发了人们对政府越权的愤慨。
entries.en: Banning a popular drama has sparked outrage against government overreach.

entries.zh: 对强化改造实验失败受害者家属进行补偿。
entries.en: Compensation provided to the families of those who suffer from failed experimental augmentations.

entries.zh: 我们已经摒弃了对信仰的暧昧，毫不拖延地推进我们的义体化倡议。
entries.en: We have cast speculations of faith aside to further our cyberization initiative without delay.

entries.zh: 强制征召测试对象将会让我们更容易完成目标。
entries.en: Forcibly recruiting test subjects will help us to reach our objectives.

entries.zh: 少儿很早就会接受义体科技的强化改造。
entries.en: The young are promptly augmented with cybernetic technology.

entries.zh: 青少年在不受强化改造的情况下自由发展。
entries.en: The young are free to develop without augmentations.

entries.zh: 人工智能增强的突触响应有助于指导人们从事生产任务。
entries.en: AI-augmented synaptic responses help direct people towards productive tasks.

entries.zh: 深入到大脑的决策制定中枢的植入体使得政府能够进行高度管控。
entries.en: Implants deep within the brain's decision making centers permit a high level of government control.

entries.zh: 对媒体的完全封锁可使针对政府目标的批评噤声。
entries.en: A complete media blackout has silenced critique directed at the government's objectives.

entries.zh: 肢体当然是越多越好了，特别是在实验室里。
entries.en: More arms are better than less, especially in the lab.

entries.zh: 整合式外加躯干增强了军队。
entries.en: The integration of additional limbs has bolstered the military.

entries.zh: 为所有行动不便者提供多肢体强化改造。
entries.en: Multi-limb augmentations are provided to all those with compromised mobility.

entries.zh: 多肢体强化改造只应给肯出价者享用。
entries.en: Multi-limb augmentations are available to the highest bidders.

entries.zh: 通过开创性的多肢体强化改造技术，工人阶级获得了肢的提升。
entries.en: The working class has been given a hand up through pioneering multi-limb augmentations.

entries.zh: 权利意味着特权：精英们有更优先获得多肢体的权利。
entries.en: With power comes privilege: the elite have more right to multiple limbs.

entries.zh: 实验性强化改造的受害者被追授为仪式祭品，以终结他们的痛苦。
entries.en: Victims of experimental augmentations are offered a ritual sacrifice to end their suffering.

entries.zh: 制药行业专注于为有需要的义体化个体开发有效的止痛药物。
entries.en: The pharmaceutical industry focuses on developing potent pain relief medication for cyberized individuals in need.

entries.zh: 只有公民有权选择不接受实验。
entries.en: Only citizens have the right to opt out of testing.

entries.zh: 政府拒绝承担责任引发了强烈的政治反对。
entries.en: The state's refusal to take accountability has sparked significant political opposition.

entries.zh: 商业化植入体可根据需要提供化学诱导的享受和幸福感。
entries.en: Commercialized implants offer a chemically induced sense of enjoyment and well-being on demand.

entries.zh: 通过有问题的途径获得的不稳定植入体可以一键生成快乐和健康。
entries.en: Unstable implants acquired via questionable means offer enjoyment and health with the press of a button.

entries.zh: 政府满足于监管现有的娱乐和再生模组，而不打算自行生产。
entries.en: The government is content with regulating existing enjoyment and regenerative mods without its own production.

entries.zh: 人们不需要分别存储在工作和在家时的记忆部分。
entries.en: People are not required to isolate sections of their memory when working or at home.

entries.zh: 要求人们在离开工作岗位后区分于工作有关的记忆以避免商业泄密。
entries.en: People are required to isolate job-related memories when leaving the workplace to prevent industrial espionage.

entries.zh: 要求人们完全分离与工作有关的和闲暇时间的记忆，为了避免商业泄密和与雇主之间的道德冲突。
entries.en: People are required to fully separate work-related memories from their leisure time and vice versa to prevent industry espionage and ethics conflicts with the employer.

entries.zh: 父母可以控制未成年子女的运动机能。
entries.en: Parents are given control over their underaged children's motor functions.

entries.zh: 父母可以有限地控制未成年子女，例如奔跑和输出音量等。
entries.en: Parents are allowed limited control over their underaged children, such as control over their running and volume output levels.

entries.zh: 尽管父母反对，但运动功能的控制只保留给执法者。
entries.en: Despite parental objections, motor function controls are reserved for enforcers only.

entries.zh: 以牺牲其他领域研究为代价，将与工程学有关的专业知识传输至科学家们的意识中。
entries.en: Engineering-related expertise is transferred to the minds of scientists at the cost of other research fields.

entries.zh: 以牺牲其他领域研究为代价，将与物理学有关的专业知识传输至科学家们的意识中。
entries.en: Physics-related expertise is transferred to the minds of scientists at the cost of other research fields.

entries.zh: 以牺牲其他领域研究为代价，将与社会学有关的专业知识传输至科学家们的意识中。
entries.en: Society-related expertise is transferred to the minds of scientists at the cost of other research fields.

entries.zh: 对义体植入体的原材料和生产施以重税。
entries.en: Heavy taxation on materials and production of cybernetic implants.

entries.zh: 对义体植入体的原材料及生产的税收改革将带来短期效益。
entries.en: Reformed taxation on materials and production of cybernetic implants leads to short-term profits.

entries.zh: 起诉那些生产最劣质义体植入体的商家来提高标准。
entries.en: Producers of the shoddiest cybernetic implants are prosecuted to improve standards.

entries.zh: 允许公民安装个人武器植入体。
entries.en: Citizens are allowed to install personal weapon implants.

entries.zh: 所有以伤害他人为设计目的的植入体都将被收缴，并重新装上更明智的产品。
entries.en: All implants made with the intention of hurting others are being gathered and reassembled into more sensible products.

entries.zh: 拥有核心植入体控制源代码的黑客可以访问——甚至操弄——其他人的植入体。
entries.en: Hackers with the source code for core implant control can access - and manipulate - the implants of others.

entries.zh: 数据采集人员通过我们的通讯网络追踪非法入侵植入体的黑客。
entries.en: Data divers trace illegal implant hacking through our communication networks.

entries.zh: 我们这些已经习惯于强化改造不断推陈出新的人口对最近的产出的迟滞表示强烈不满。
entries.en: Our population, accustomed to a steady stream of new augmentations, are up in arms over recent product delays.

entries.zh: 打断针对我们的植入体安装日程延期的抗议示威活动。
entries.en: Demonstrations against the delays in our implantation schedule are being broken up.

entries.zh: 对我们的社会而言，全人口范围的植入是必要的，但那些完全义体化的反对者可以选择有限的强化改造。
entries.en: Population-wide implants are necessary for our society, but those against full cyberization may opt for limited augmentation.

entries.zh: §W义体唯心主义领袖特质：§!§Y$leader_trait_cyborg$§!\n§W义体唯心主义人口受到$mod_cyborg_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$增益作用§!
entries.en: §WCybernetic Spiritualist Leader Trait:§! §Y$leader_trait_cyborg$§!\n§WCybernetic Spiritualist Pops benefit from $mod_cyborg_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$§!

entries.zh: 所有个体都应进行全套的义体植入体安装。\n\n§E$cyberization_standards_full_effect$§!
entries.en: All individuals are expected to undergo the installation of a complete set of cybernetic implants.\n\n§E$cyberization_standards_full_effect$§!

entries.zh: §W义体唯心主义领袖特质：§!§Y$leader_trait_limited_cyborg$§!\n§R义体唯心主义人口不受$mod_cyborg_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$增益作用§!
entries.en: §WCybernetic Spiritualist Leader Trait:§! §Y$leader_trait_limited_cyborg$§!\n§RCybernetic Spiritualist Pops do not benefit from $mod_cyborg_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$§!

entries.zh: 完全强化改造的反对者可以安装一套有限的义体植入体。\n\n§E$cyberization_standards_limited_effect$§!
entries.en: Individuals against full augmentation can install a limited set of cybernetic implants.\n\n§E$cyberization_standards_limited_effect$§!

entries.zh: 义体工蜂得到§Y$mod_cyborg_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$§!的全部增益，但受到§R-5%§!$MOD_LOGISTIC_GROWTH_MULT$。
entries.en: Cybernetic Drones fully benefit from §Y$mod_cyborg_pop_bonus_workforce_mult$§!, but suffer §R-5%§! $MOD_LOGISTIC_GROWTH_MULT$.

entries.zh: 淘汰那些拒绝向体内进行义体植入的无人机是为了提高效率而做出的牺牲。\n\n$cyberization_standards_full_hive_effect$
entries.en: Culling drones with bodies that reject cybernetic implants is a sacrifice made for greater efficiency.\n\n$cyberization_standards_full_hive_effect$

entries.zh: 为缺陷工蜂安装有限的义体植入体，使其能够继续贡献力量。\n\n$cyberization_standards_limited_hive_effect$
entries.en: Outfitting defective drones with limited cybernetic implants allows them to continue to contribute.\n\n$cyberization_standards_limited_hive_effect$

entries.zh: 最近在高等义体植入体方面的突破有朝一日将产生重塑社会的可能性。我们可以消除一切生物学弱点，变得更快、更强、更聪明。
entries.en: Recent breakthroughs in advanced cybernetic implants will one day make it possible to reshape society. By eliminating any biological weakness, we can make ourselves smarter, faster, stronger.

entries.zh: 最近在高等义体植入体方面的突破有朝一日将产生重塑社会的可能性，这次将由我们自己掌控。通过消除现有增强技术中的生物学缺陷和弱点，我们可以使自己变得更聪明、更快、更强壮。
entries.en: Recent breakthroughs in advanced cybernetic implants will one day make it possible to reshape society, this time on our own terms. By eliminating biological weaknesses and defects in our existing augments, we can make ourselves smarter, faster, stronger.

entries.zh: $cyber.100.desc.shared$\n\n各大企业提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而政府官员则坚持必须保证由国家来控制这种潜在的技术。
entries.en: $cyber.100.desc.shared$\n\nCorporations have provided business proposals and sales projections, while government officials argue that access to this potential technology must be guaranteed by the state.

entries.zh: $cyber.100.desc.shared_unplugged$\n\n各大企业提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而政府官员则坚持必须保证由国家来控制这种潜在的技术。
entries.en: $cyber.100.desc.shared_unplugged$\n\nCorporations have provided business proposals and sales projections, while government officials argue that access to this potential technology must be guaranteed by the state.

entries.zh: $cyber.100.desc.shared$\n\n各分包商提出了一些商业提案和销售前景预测，然而我们的董事会则坚持必须保证这种重要技术在垄断范围之内。
entries.en: $cyber.100.desc.shared$\n\nSub-contractors have provided business proposals and sales projections for third-party implant production, while our board of directors argues that access to this important technology must remain within our monopoly.

entries.zh: $cyber.100.desc.shared_unplugged$\n\n分包商提供了第三方植入体生产的商业提案和销售前景预测，而我公司董事会则坚持这项重要技术的准入必须保持在我们垄断之下。
entries.en: $cyber.100.desc.shared_unplugged$\n\nSub-contractors have provided business proposals and sales projections for third-party implant production, while our board of directors argues that access to this important technology must remain within our monopoly.

entries.zh: 我们将国有化强化改造产业。
entries.en: We will nationalize the augmentation industry.

entries.zh: 我们将私有化分发流程。

entries.en: By the People, For the People

entries.zh: 由于我们计划的许多义体设计对普通人来说都将会遥不可及，一些自改造者们感到非常愤怒。\n\n他们认为如果公开原理图并放松有关的环境法规，几乎每个人都能制造和修理自己的强化体。
entries.en: Self-modders are furious that many of our planned cybernetic designs will be inaccessible to the average person.\n\nThey argue that if the schematics were made public and environmental regulations relaxed, almost everyone will be able to manufacture and repair their own augmentations.

entries.zh: 独立承包商们抱怨称难以获取我们计划的许多义体设计。\n\n他们认为如果公开蓝图，并将与生产有关的专利放松，将能改善义体的生产。
entries.en: Independent contractors complain that many of our planned cybernetic designs are inaccessible to them.\n\nThey argue that if the schematics were made available and patents related to production relaxed, implant production could be improved.

entries.zh: 法律法规的存在不是无缘无故的。
这可是我们的知识产权。

entries.en: Let the people craft what they like.

entries.zh: 一个研究团队提出了一项新议案，将监管人工智能集成到我们的移动设备中，随后又可以直接整合进义体件中。\n\n这些监管人工智能将会引导我们公民将关注点从无聊的任务转移到更需要脑力的任务上。虽然会因此丧失一部分自主权，但对生产力前所未有的提高将不容忽视。
entries.en: A team of researchers has put forth an innovative proposal to integrate AI supervisors into our mobile devices. Later these could be incorporated directly into cyberware.\n\nThe supervisors would redirect the focus of our citizenry away from idle tasks towards more cerebral endeavors. While some level of autonomy will be lost, the unprecedented potential to amplify our productivity cannot be overlooked.

entries.zh: 我们当将此视为一项恩赐。
entries.en: We must accept this as a blessing.

entries.zh: 这对自主权的牺牲太大了。
entries.en: The loss of autonomy is too great.

entries.zh: 我们不会在远离神圣的道路上越行越远的。
entries.en: We will not stray further from the holy path.

entries.zh: 如果能装上一键开关的话这是可以接受的。
entries.en: Acceptable, if an On/Off switch is included.

entries.zh: 这将给我们带来多少的控制权啊……
entries.en: The amount of control this will grant us...

entries.zh:
一部广受好评的新剧抓住了公众们的集体想象力。

故事发生在一个义体植入体盛行的世界里，讲述一位强化改造的工人遭遇了与改造身体的创伤性分离。故事的悲剧性结局对完全义体化及其对[Owner.Species.GetAdj]身份不可避免的抹除提出了一种几乎不加掩饰的批评。

这部剧的大获成功引发了对义体化倡议的强烈反对，自该剧播出以来，可用测试对象的注册人数骤减了60%。
entries.en:
A widely acclaimed new drama has captured the collective imagination of the public.

Set in a world where cybernetic implants are prevalent, the narrative follows an augmented worker experiencing traumatic dissociation from their modified body. The story's tragic conclusion presents a thinly veiled critique of full cyberization and its inevitable erasure of the [Owner.Species.GetAdj] identity.

The smash hit has sparked significant opposition to our initiative, causing a 60% decrease in available test subjects since the drama's release.

entries.zh: 经过一段时间的政治内斗，生产义体强化件的责任终于被瓜分到到了各个政府部门中。当他们都能分一杯羹时，肯定会互相进行监督。\n\n但计划终究要付诸行动。科研共同体至少需要一座$building_augmentation_center$来作为义体发展的中心。
entries.en: After a period of political infighting, the responsibilities for producing cybernetic augmentations have been divided between various governmental departments. When everyone gets a piece of the pie, they will surely keep each other in check.\n\nBut plans must be put into action. The research community requires at least one $building_augmentation_center$ to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

entries.zh: 曾经的梦想现在触手可及，无疑我们境内众多的公司能从中大幅获利。义体行业蓬勃发展的一个好处是，新的消费产品推陈出新的速度越来越快了。\n\n但计划终究要付诸行动。企业说客请愿建立一座$building_upload_center$来作为义体发展的中心。
entries.en: What was once a dream is now within reach, and who better to profit from it than the multitude of corporations within our borders? A benefit of the burgeoning cybernetic industry vigor is that new consumer products can be launched at an accelerated pace.\n\nBut plans must be put into action. The corporate lobbyists request at least one $building_upload_center$ to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

entries.zh: 我们的通讯网络充斥着各种疯狂的设计构想，从神经突触强化件到义体味觉腺无所不有。其中大多数都非常不切实际，而且实现起来非常昂贵，尽管有些设计看起来还是很有希望的。\n\n但计划终究要付诸行动。线上社群至少需要一座$building_augmentation_center$来作为义体发展的中心。
entries.en: Our communication networks are abuzz with wild design ideas, everything from neuro-synaptic augmentation to cybernetic taste glands. Most of these would be highly impractical and very expensive to implement, though luckily some designs appear promising.\n\nBut plans must be put into action. The online community requires at least one $building_augmentation_center$ to act as a hub for cybernetic development.

entries.zh: §R需要采取行动：§!\n建造一个£building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center']以恢复§Y$situation_cyberization$§!局势。
entries.en: §RAction required:§!\nBuild an £building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center'] to resume the §Y$situation_cyberization$§! situation.

entries.zh: 是时候上马一些规模更大的示范项目了。这需要持续的投入而且只会在建有$building_augmentation_center$的行星进行，但所获得的经验能马上提高生产力。
entries.en: The time has come for more widespread pilot projects. These require continuous support and will only be available on planets with an $building_augmentation_center$, but our learnings will give immediate productivity benefits.

entries.zh: 由政府出资研究项目所进行的小规模测试已确认机械强化改造可以提升产出。\n\n$cyber.205.desc.shared$
entries.en: Small tests conducted by government-funded research projects have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.\n\n$cyber.205.desc.shared$

entries.zh: 对焦点志愿小组进行的小规模测试已经验证了机械强化改造可以提升产出。\n\n$cyber.205.desc.shared$
entries.en: Small tests conducted on focus group volunteers have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.\n\n$cyber.205.desc.shared$

entries.zh: 来自自改造者的报道验证了机械强化改造可以提升产出。\n\n$cyber.205.desc.shared$
entries.en: Reports by self-modders have confirmed that mechanical augmentations improve productivity.\n\n$cyber.205.desc.shared$

entries.zh: 记者们揭露了政府正在资助涉及思想监控芯片实验的证据。一旦这些设备开发完成，就可以安装在公民的大脑中，收集详细的安全和人格数据。
entries.en: Journalists have uncovered proof of government-funded experiments that involve thought-monitoring microchips. Fully developed, these devices could be installed in the minds of citizens to gather detailed security and personality insights.

entries.zh: 一项与商标纠纷有关的法庭证据表明，企业正在试验增强现实植入体，旨在无缝连接到消费者的视神经上。原理图列出了对用户的好处，还有企业劫持视觉信息的能力。
entries.en: Court evidence related to a trademark dispute has shown that corporations are experimenting with augmented reality implants, designed to attach seamlessly to a consumer's optical nerve. The schematics outline both the benefits to the user, as well as the ability for a company to hijack visual information.

entries.zh: 独立的自我改装者已经开始用基本的机械替代品替换肢体。不但没有任何办法可以确保这些自行手术的人的福利，而且人们还担心这种植入体不受管控的应用可能弊大于利。
entries.en: Independent self-modders have already started replacing limbs with rudimentary mechanical alternatives. There is no way to ensure the welfare of anyone attempting this on their own, and there are fears that unregulated use of implants could do more harm than good.
We can make use of this.

entries.zh: 我们在神经接口领域取得了显著的突破。大脑信号增幅器可以让用户丝滑但有限地操控一组人工肢体。在未来，这种技术也可以直接整合进义体脑中，而不需要外接设备。\n\n在初步测试阶段，测试对象展现出了更高的敏捷性和精确的物体操纵能力，甚至还有更高的战斗熟练程度。然而，对制造成本的担忧促使人们应定夺这项开创性技术应优先运用于什么人群上。
entries.en: A significant breakthrough has been achieved in the field of neural interfaces. A brain signal amplifier could grant users seamless, but limited control over an array of artificial limbs. Later on, this could be integrated directly to a cyberbrain without the need for an external device.\n\nDuring the initial testing phase, subjects exhibited promising results with dexterity and object manipulation alongside heightened combat proficiency. However, concerns regarding the manufacturing costs have prompted the need to decide who should have first access to this pioneering technology.

entries.zh: 优先让那些受到残障限制的人重获自由吧。
entries.en: First, give a hand to those with physical limitations.

entries.zh: 手当然是要给最舍得出手的人。
entries.en: No handouts! Sell to the highest bidder.

entries.zh: 精英们的优势是最手要的。
entries.en: The elite should always have the upper hand.

entries.zh: 一款新型脊柱模块的试验以灾难性的失败告终。植入体电机产生的过大力量导致多名测试对象的脊髓遭受永久性损伤。\n\n这一可怕结果的图片被泄露引起了公众的不适，导致未来实验的志愿者严重短缺。
entries.en: A trial run of a new spinal module has ended in a catastrophic failure. The excess power generated by the implant's motors has resulted in permanent spinal cord injuries for multiple test subjects.\n\nDisturbing images showcasing the horrifying outcome have leaked to the public, causing an acute shortage of volunteers for future experiments.

entries.zh: 在找到解决方案之前暂停所有测试。
entries.en: Pause all tests until a solution is found.

entries.zh: 向受害者家属进行补偿。
如果找不到人当志愿者，可以来硬的。
entries.en: Find volunteers. By force if necessary.

entries.zh: 我们在全国各地的所有主要城市中心为[Owner.Species.GetName]民众们囤积了大量的机械植入体。这些由$job_augmentor_plural$们设计的装置保证可以大幅提高我们的生理机能。\n\n抛弃过往迎接义体未来的这一天终于到了。
entries.en: All across our territory, in every major urban center, we have stockpiled mechanical implants for our [Owner.Species.GetName] population. Designed by our $job_augmentor_plural$, these devices promise to greatly enhance our biological forms.\n\nThe day is finally here to cast off our past and embrace a cybernetic future.

强化改造速度取决于局势应对方案和£building£['building:building_augmentation_center']建筑的数量。

Leaders Gain Trait: §Y$leader_trait_cyborg$§!
Pops Gain Trait: ['trait:trait_cybernetic']

Augmentation speed depends on the situation approach and the number of £building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center'] buildings.

entries.zh: 在实践中，他们甚至缺乏最基本的植入体，这使得他们难以在我们这个日益紧密联系起来的社会中发挥作用。\n\n强制要求每个人都安装完整的植入体将有助于他们更好地融入社会，但无疑会导致怨恨。
entries.en: In practice, they lack even the most basic implants, making it difficult to function in our increasingly connected society.\n\nForcing the population to install full implants would help them to better integrate with society, but would undoubtedly lead to resentment.

entries.zh: 反对将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械融为一体的宗教团体主动退出了我们义体化人口的行动。$cyber.305.desc.shared$
entries.en: Religious groups opposed to the merging of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine have opted out of our efforts to cyberize the population. $cyber.305.desc.shared$

entries.zh: 不情愿将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与机械苟同的虔信者们主动退出了我们义体化人口的行动。$cyber.305.desc.shared$
entries.en: The faithful, understandably reluctant to merge [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine, have opted out of our efforts to cyberize the population. $cyber.305.desc.shared$

entries.zh: 将[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]和机械融合的道德性是个长久以来为人津津乐道的话题。不幸的是，考虑到义体化带来的效率提高，那些选择退出的人可能处于不利地位。\n\n强迫人们安装植入体可以确保所有人都不会掉队，但这也无疑会导致怨恨。
entries.en: The morality of merging [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine has long been a subject of debate. Unfortunately, given the increased efficiency that results from cyberization, those who opt out may be at a disadvantage.\n\nForcing the population to install implants would ensure that no one is left behind, but it will also undoubtedly lead to resentment.

entries.zh: 再次融合[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]与机器的道德性是个长久以来为人津津乐道的话题。然而，我们自主设计的增强器不再受同化我们的机器摆布，因此效率极高。那些选择推出的人可能会处于不利地位。\n\n强迫人们安装植入体可以确保所有人都不会掉队，但这也无疑会导致怨恨。
entries.en: The morality of once again merging [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine has long been a subject of debate. However, augments of our own design are no longer bound to the whims of the Machine that assimilated us, and as such are exceedingly efficient. Those who opt out may be at a disadvantage.\n\nForcing the population to install implants would ensure that no one is left behind, but it will also undoubtedly lead to resentment.

entries.zh: 宗教算什么，我们必须前进。
entries.en: Faith is irrelevant, we march onward.

entries.zh: 随着为新生儿安装植入体的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这些开创性的新生儿强化改造拥有永远改变我们与技术的关系的力量，从幼年开始便解放先天的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向前所未有的高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
entries.en: With our newfound capability to insert implants onto newborns, we have suddenly reached an impasse. These pioneering neonatal augmentations possess the power to forever transform our bond with technology, unlocking innate cybernetic potential from an early age and propelling our civilization to unprecedented heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

entries.zh: 最近，我们取得了一项令人难以置信的突破，使微芯片直接植入幼体体内变为可能。在变态发育过程中，我们的幼体获得了一种吸收机械系统的自然能力。在化蛹阶段进行的增强可以释放他们未开发的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向惊人的新高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
entries.en: Recently, we have made an incredible breakthrough which allows us to implant microchips directly onto our young. During metamorphosis, our larvae have a natural ability to absorb mechanical systems. Augmentations made during the pupal stage can unleash their untapped cybernetic potential and propel our civilization to astonishing new heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

entries.zh: 随着将植入体安装进新结晶后代的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这样的强化改造将使我们的新一代与金属矿物形成一种自然的联系，从很小的时候就释放出他们的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向惊人的新高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
entries.en: Amidst our newfound capability to insert implants onto newly crystallized offspring, we have suddenly reached an impasse. Such augmentations would allow our young to form a natural bond with metallic minerals, unlocking their cybernetic potential from an early age and propelling our civilization to astonishing new heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

entries.zh: 随着将植入体安装进新嫩芽的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这样的强化改造将使我们的新一代通过菌丝网络传输电子脉冲，从很小的时候就释放出他们的义体潜力。$cyber.320.end.desc$
entries.en: Amidst our newfound capability to insert cybernetic implants onto sproutlings, we have suddenly reached an impasse. These augmentations would allow our young to transmit electrical impulses through an enhanced network of hyphae, unlocking their cybernetic potential from an early age.$cyber.320.end.desc$

entries.zh: 随着将植入体安装进幼雏的全新技术问世，我们突然陷入了僵局。这样的先进强化改造拥有将以科技永久重塑骨骼的能力，从很小的时候就释放出他们的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向惊人的新高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
entries.en: Amidst our newfound capability to insert implants directly onto hatchlings, we have suddenly reached an impasse. These pioneering augmentations possess the power to forever transform their bond with technology, unlocking innate cybernetic potential from an early age and propelling our civilization to unprecedented heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

entries.zh: 随着将植入体安装进幼体的全新技术问世，我们也同时陷入了僵局：这样的先进强化改造拥有将以科技永久重塑骨骼的能力，从很小的时候就释放出他们的义体潜力，并将我们的文明推向惊人的新高度。$cyber.320.end.desc$
entries.en: With the capability to insert cybernetic implants into infants, we also arrive at an impasse: these pioneering augmentations possess the power to forever transform our bond with technology, unlocking innate cybernetic potential from an early age and propelling our civilization to unprecedented heights.$cyber.320.end.desc$

entries.zh: \n\n然而，如果从这么小的时候就开始依赖于义体强化，可能会导致我们的物种最终失去在自然状态下生存的能力。
entries.en: \n\nHowever, creating a reliance on cybernetic enhancement from such an early age could eventually result in our species losing the capability to survive in our natural state.

entries.zh: 进化对我们是自然而然的事情。
entries.en: It is only natural for us to evolve.

entries.zh: 童年必须保持纯天然无污染。
entries.en: We must preserve a natural childhood.

entries.zh: 最近，一些个体开始公开表达对接受实验性身体改造的懊悔。将脑干换成机械替代品会导致持久的生存恐惧，一些人将他们的经历描述为无法忍受的痛苦的持续循环。\n\n在不断要求赔偿的情况下，我们不得不澄清我们对国家责任的立场。
entries.en: Recently, a number of individuals have begun to publicly express remorse over their decision to undergo experimental body modifications. Exchanging the brainstem for a mechanical substitute has resulted in lasting existential dread, with some describing their experience as a continuous cycle of unbearable agony.\n\nAmidst ongoing demands for reparations, we are forced to clarify our position regarding the state's responsibility.

entries.zh: 献祭会结束他们的痛苦。
在最底层寻找测试对象。
entries.en: Look to the lowest strata for test subjects.

entries.zh: 目睹了监管宽松的强化改造行业带来的利润，当地政府官员一直在争先恐后地跟上最新的发展。从资源开采到最终安装，控制植入体生产的每个阶段都要征收大幅税额。\n\n过分的官僚主义和高昂的费用已经减缓了我们的强化改造进度，阻碍了全面义体化的进程。
entries.en: Witnessing the profits in the loosely regulated augmentation industry, local government officials have been scrambling to keep up with the latest developments. Broad taxes have been levied on every stage of cybernetic implant production, from resource extraction to final installation.\n\nThe additional bureaucracy and expense have slowed down our augmentation process, impeding progress toward full cyberization.

entries.zh: 由于跟不上公众对控制植入体的采用，我们的立法者正在尽其所能限制某些方面的强化改造。\n\n最新提出的法规谴责我们“植入体成瘾”，每一次强化改造都“让我们离[Owner.Species.GetName]的定义越来越远”，并设定了一个每个人的强化体比例上限，只有在该限度之内才资格受到法律保护。毕竟，在某种程度上，我们有会变得更像机器而不是[Owner.Species.GetName]的风险。
entries.en: Unable to keep up with the public's adoption of cybernetic implants, our lawmakers are doing everything they can to restrict certain aspects of augmentation.\n\nDecrying our "implant obsession," with each augmentation "taking us further away from what it means to be a [Owner.Species.GetName]," the latest proposed regulations set a maximum augmentation percentage per person allowed to still qualify for protection under the law. After all, at some point we risk becoming more machine than [Owner.Species.GetName].

entries.zh: 在对利润的狂热追逐中，强化改造市场充斥着廉价、低质的植入体，在这些设备不可避免地发生故障时，公司也拒绝提供客户支持。\n\n在一个最近广为报道的案例中，一位著名演员在舞台上表演时，心脏调节植入体发生了故障。不幸的是，结果是爆炸性的。
entries.en: In the heady rush for profit, the augmentation market has been flooded by cheap, low-quality implants, with companies offering no customer support when these devices inevitably break down.\n\nIn one recent, well-publicized case, a popular performer's heart-modulating implant malfunctioned while on stage. The result was, unfortunately, explosive.
The market will sort itself out.

entries.zh: 我们必须确保用户安全。
最近，一种引人疑虑的新型义体植入体得到了广泛的关注。这些植入体的设计不是为了帮助使用者，而是为了伤害他人：这些毒素喷雾器、纳米绞杀器和电子大脑干扰器席卷了大街小巷。\n\n支持者认为，这些植入体对于自卫是必要的，而其他人则坚持认为，这种技术不可能带来任何好处。
entries.en: Recently, a dubious new variety of cybernetic implant has been gaining traction. These implants are not designed to help the user, but rather to injure others: toxin sprayers, nano garrottes, and cyberbrain scramblers flood our streets.\n\nProponents argue that these implants are necessary for self defense, while others insist no good can possibly come of such technology.

entries.zh: 必须拆除所有的暴力植入体。
entries.en: All violent implants must be dismantled.

entries.zh: 用这些材料造点更……明智的东西。\n\n
entries.en: Use the materials to build something more... sensible.\n\n

entries.zh: 在一次协同攻击中，多个黑客组织协力盗取了驱动所有植入体的核心软件。他们威胁称，如果我们不答应他们的要求，就要把代码公布于众。\n\n到目前为止，我们没有理由怀疑他们的决心。如果代码被公开，我们将别无选择，只能进行重写，这种延迟将对我们的强化改造工作造成毁灭性的影响。
entries.en: In a coordinated attack, multiple hacker groups have gained access to the core software that powers all cybernetic implants. They are threatening to release the code to the public unless we give in to their demands.\n\nThus far, we have no reason to doubt their resolve. Should the code be made public, we will have no choice but to rewrite it, a delay that will have a devastating impact on our augmentation efforts.

entries.zh: 我倒要看看他们想怎么搞。
entries.en: I'd like to see them try.

entries.zh: 好在我们自己的黑客道高一丈。
entries.en: Good thing we keep the best hackers on OUR payroll.

entries.zh: 尽管我们向入侵安全系统的组织支付了巨额赎金，但昨晚我们的主要代码库还是被上传到了所有公共信息网络。泄露的内容开头还附带一张淫秽图片，嘲笑我们无力阻止攻击。\n\n公众舆论逐渐发酵，对控制植入体的“买家懊悔”明显增加了。
entries.en: Despite paying a massive ransom to the groups responsible for the security breach, late last night our primary code base was uploaded to on every public information network. The leak was preceded by an obscene graphic, mocking our inability to prevent the attacks.\n\nPublic discourse has already turned bitter, with a noticeable increase in 'buyer's remorse' for cybernetic implants.

entries.zh: 重写植入体控制程序费时费力，减慢了产出的节奏。\n\n由于民众越来越依赖于最新的强化体，许多人走上街头抗议产品的延期发售。
entries.en: Rewriting the implant control software has taken time and effort, and slowed down production.\n\nThe population has become ever more dependent on the latest augments, and many have taken to the streets to protest delayed product launches.

entries.zh: 今天是我们社会的一个转折点。我们终于得以用全内置机械部件来强化改造自己的躯体。\n\n这个过程并非一帆风顺，转变远非易事。但无论付出了什么代价，现在的新躯体已经将无尽的可能性展开在了我们的面前。
entries.en: Today marks a turning point for our society. We are now able to augment our bodies with fully-integrated machine parts.\n\nThe process was not without difficulty, the transition far from easy. But whatever may have been lost along the way, our new existence offers endless possibilities.

entries.zh: 我们不安于自然所给予的现状，努力地超越了有机躯体的极限。全面铺开的植入体应用只遭遇了微不足道的问题，并且都已逐一迎刃而解。绝大多数人口为全新的义体所带来的一切感到欣喜若狂。\n\n我们正站在成就伟大的大门前，未来可期。
entries.en: We refuse to settle for what nature provided, and instead strive to exceed the limits of the organic body. Our full-scale distribution of implants has encountered only minor issues, all of which can be easily resolved. The vast majority of the population is exhilarated by what their new cybernetics offer.\n\nWe truly stand on the precipice of greatness. What happens next remains to be seen.

entries.zh: 义体化不会让我们忘了自己是谁。
entries.en: Cyberization does not change who we are.

entries.zh: 高度先进的神经安全措施让公民可以完全、实时、直接地参与决定政策的投票。\n\n这种民主政府定期举行选举，有公民都可以投票选出代表他们的议员。
entries.en: Highly advanced neurosecurity protocols allow citizens to vote on policy decisions in real-time directly.\n\nThis democratic government holds regular elections where all citizens can vote on who should represent them.

entries.zh: 意识交互界面可以促成全义体人之间实时的传感器数据、情感响应和思维模式共享。为了防止发生强烈的外体响应敏感性，情感防火墙会过滤掉对共享情感数据包的不必要反应。\n\n这种民主政府定期举行选举，有公民都可以投票选出代表他们的议员。
entries.en: Consciousness interfaces allow real-time sharing of sensory data, emotional responses, and thought patterns between full cyborgs. As a safeguard against the sensitivity of intense extra-body responses, emotional firewalls filter out unwanted responses to shared emotive data packets.\n\nThis democratic government holds regular elections where all citizens can vote on who should represent them.

entries.zh: 互联派系没有诉求。进入大互联的义体人口自由共享经验，且不需要政治特权。
entries.en: The Interlink has no demands. Cyborg pops connected to the Interlink share their experiences freely, requiring no political concessions.

entries.en: Specialist biochips are remotely overclocked for increased production while the ruling strata reaps the benefits, allowing them to allocate more time to politics and leisure.

entries.zh: 最近湿件的进步使得控制睡眠成为可能。受试对象的神经通路与服务器相连，服务器向大脑输入计算任务，或命令他们的身体执行重复性工作。这就是字面意义上的“梦中的工作”。
entries.en: Recent wetware advancements have made it possible to control people in their sleep. The subject's neural pathways are connected to servers, which feed the brain computational tasks or command their body to perform repetitive work. A real dream job.

entries.en: This faction might produce more £physics_research£ £society_research£ £engineering_research£ research.

entries.zh: 强制植入为我们提供了强有力的控制和执法的工具，加强了政权对其臣民的控制。这种俗称为“独裁芯片”的植入体可以监视它们的宿主，并在出现问题时自动向当局发出警报。
entries.en: Mandatory implantation provides robust control and law enforcement tools, strengthening the regime's grip over its subjects. The colloquially named "dictator-chips" monitor their owners and alert the authorities automatically if trouble arises.

entries.zh: 独裁者的个人崇拜和对臣民的影响力通过控制植入物得到了增强。敬畏领袖的人民不太可能反抗政权。
entries.en: The dictator's cult of personality and reach over their subjects have been empowered via cybernetic implants. A people in awe of their leader are unlikely to rebel against the regime.

entries.zh: 皇位的指定继承人所继承的不仅仅是皇位，还有代代相传的专属植入体。其中包含了祖祖辈辈积累下来的无价知识财富，传授如何治理国家的各种智慧。相同的技术也以一种较小的形式在整个帝国中使用，其他人也能类似地传承经验。
entries.en: The designated successor of the imperial throne inherits not only the position but a specialized implant passed through generations. It contains a wealth of priceless knowledge from their predecessors, imparting all types of wisdom on how to govern. The same technology is used throughout the empire in a lesser form, allowing other individuals to pass on their experiences onwards.

entries.zh: 该高度先进的强化体存储了过往的每位拥有者所积累的经验，让统治者可以一代代的累积知识。
entries.en: This advanced augmentation stores the experiences of its past owners, allowing rulers to accumulate knowledge over multiple generations.

entries.zh: 我们的统治者正在深挖§Y$r_the_rulerchip$§!的存储核心以提升知识水平。
entries.en: Our ruler is diving into the §Y$r_the_rulerchip$§! memory core to improve their knowledge base.

entries.en: The imperial network allows the entire population to access whole new avenues of mass-entertainment. A massive $building_cyberdome$ can be built to the capital to host ferocious cybersports with augmented athletes and broadcast this across multiple worlds.

entries.zh: 举办强化改造运动员之间野蛮的义体竞技以娱乐帝国公民。增强的角斗士、运动员和短跑运动员为观众的青睐互相角逐，直到受伤或死亡为止。
entries.en: Hosts savage cybersports with augmented athletes for the entertainment of the imperial citizens. Enhanced gladiators, athletes and sprinters compete for our favor until damaged or dead.

entries.zh: 广告牌和手持设备等过时的工具无法完全吸引消费者的注意力，而现在我们可以扫描潜在客户的思想，将特定的信息和强调的行动呼吁直接发送到个人的大脑中。\n\n这一创新也使我们能够监控恒星基地的访客是否有海盗活动，但也可能会产生对黑市信号屏蔽器的需求。
entries.en: Outmoded tools such as billboards and hand-held devices have failed to fully capture a consumer's attention. We can now scan the minds of potential customers and beam specific messaging and emphatic calls-to-action directly into an individual brain.\n\nThis innovation also allows us to monitor visitors across our starbases for pirate activity, but is likely to create a demand for black market signal blockers.

entries.zh: 改良，是一种积极进取的态度，是一种现代软件和湿件环境下的坚实哲学。多元化的升级选择为我们的客户群提供了个人成就和社会协作的手段。\n\n其中也留了一个用于监控所有连接到恒星基地网络用户的后门。然而，强化体的巨大利润空间可能会创造一个地下转售市场。
entries.en: Kaizen, the will to continuously improve, is a sound philosophy for the modern software and wetware environment. An extensive selection of upgrades affords our customer base individual achievement and the means towards social synergy.\n\nThey also contain a backdoor for monitoring all users connected to starbase networks. However, the augments' substantial profit margins are likely to create an underground resale market.

entries.zh: 将个人投票流的杂音划分为可管理的数据块，从而显著提高响应速度。
entries.en: The cacophony of the individualized voting streams is divided into manageable data chunks, significantly improving response speed.

entries.zh: 通过远程关闭大脑的威胁响应机制，强化了公民接受危险工作的意愿。
entries.en: By remotely disabling the threat response mechanisms of the brain, enhanced citizens accept riskier work assignments.

entries.zh: 激活一个游戏化的配额界面，吸引专家和劳工竞争晋升和绩效徽章。这种无休止的折磨部分抵消了生产率的提高。
entries.en: Activate a gamified quota interface to entice specialists and workers to compete for promotions and performance badges. The nature of the endless grind partially offsets the increase in productivity.

entries.zh: 寡头政治点明了当前被剥削派系艰苦卓绝的努力，提升了他们的支持度和吸引力。这种短暂的美名也为社会流动打开了一扇大门。
entries.en: The oligarchy highlights the incredible efforts of the currently exploited faction, increasing their approval and attraction. This fleeting fame can also lead to increased social mobility.

entries.en: Satisfies the §Y$faction_demand_STATELY_ACCLIAM$§! Faction Demand\nExtorted Faction Ethics Attraction: §G+50%§!

entries.zh: 施行§Y$edict_stately_acclaim$§!法令以点明[Root.GetName]付出的努力。
entries.en: Enact the §Y$edict_stately_acclaim$§! edict to highlight the efforts of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 启用隐藏的个人植入体功能，该功能使用启发式实时馈送分析，可以不通过所有者同意对犯罪行为进行检测和上报。
entries.en: Enables a hidden personal implant feature which uses heuristic live feed analysis to detect and report crimes without requiring the owner's consent.

entries.zh: 触发植入体产生更多的信息素等化学物质，以诱使帝国不同地区的人产生更多“多情”的行为。
entries.en: Triggers implants to produce more pheromones and other chemicals in order to coax more "amorous" behavior towards other people in different parts of the empire.

entries.zh: 通过义体设备提取我们人口的知识，可以在避免将时间浪费在低级劳动的前提下提升领袖的经验。
entries.en: By extracting our population's knowledge using cybernetics, we can improve our leader's experience without wasting their time with menial tasks.

entries.zh: 自从将首都的义体斗兽场中残酷的赛事画面直接通过神经广播给义体大脑以来，人们纷纷涌向首都。观众们可以安全地身处于荚舱中，以第一人称的方式欣赏角斗士的体验。这是比赛之年！
entries.en: By neurocasting the brutal sport spectacles of the capital's Cyberdome directly to the cyberbrain, people flock to the capital. With their bodies safe in pods, spectators share the gladiators' experiences in first-person. A year of games!
