广泛的网络调研和实时数据分析让我们可以对市场的动向以前所未有的速度进行评估和调整。资源被转移到具有最高利润潜力的功能和产品上。
entries.en: Extensively networked surveys and real-time data analysis enable us to gauge and react to market shifts faster than ever before. Resources are diverted to features and products with the highest profit potential.

entries.zh: 植入体更新的自动化和用户自主部署功能消除了对整体基础设施的需求。这也让我们在面对恶意网络入侵时棋高一着。
entries.en: Automated and user-independent deployment of implant updates removes the need for monolithic infrastructure. This also keeps us one step ahead of hostile cyber-incursions.

entries.zh: 影响进行中的§Y义体社会变迁§!。\n\n
对我们人民的强化改造是一场流水线生产流程和决策指定的重大胜利。众多不同的声音得到了倾听，他们所关切的问题也得到了解决。如今，每一名§Y[root.GetSpeciesAdj]§!都有平等的机会享受这些改变一生的植入体。\n\n合乎逻辑的下一步是对这项技术的更广泛影响进行研究。我们是利用它来推动民主进程，还是通过经验同步来提升我们的劳工？
entries.en: The augmentation of our people has been a triumph of streamlined manufacturing processes and decision-making. Our multitude of distinct voices have been acknowledged with their concerns addressed. Now, every single §Y[root.GetSpeciesAdj]§! has equal opportunity to benefit from these life-altering implants.\n\nThe logical next step is to examine the wider implications of this technology. Are we to leverage it for the democratic process or elevate our workers via experience synchronization?

entries.zh: 我们与合作公司的强化改造流程已经成功完成。植入体以惊人的效率制造、分发和安装。我们听取了§Y[root.GetSpeciesAdj]§!社会的许多意见，他们的合理关切也得到了处理。我们已经准备好了以全新的活力面对未来。\n\n政府现在准备采取下一步行动。我们可以利用技术进步来改善民主进程，或者为劳动者进行植入体同步。
entries.en: The augmentation process with our partnered corporations has been successfully completed. Implants have been manufactured, distributed, and installed with staggering efficiency. The many voices of §Y[root.GetSpeciesAdj]§! society have been heard, and their legitimate concerns have been dealt with. We are ready to face the future with renewed vigor.\n\nThe government is now prepared to take its own next step. We can use our technological advances to improve the democratic process or synchronize implants in the service of workers.

entries.zh: 尽管政府官员有些担心，但植入体的去中心化分发模式还是奏效了。小诊所和服务机构如雨后春笋般出现在大街小巷，让人们无需长途跋涉就能完成自身的强化改造。\n\n我们的政府也必须做好继续前进的准备。我们可以利用技术进步来改善民主流程，或是进行经验同步，为自己与劳动者们造福。
entries.en: Despite some apprehension from government officials, the decentralized distribution model of the implants has worked. Small clinics and services are popping up on every street corner allowing anyone to augment themselves without having to travel great distances.\n\nOur government must be ready to move on as well. We can either use the implants to strengthen our democratic process or use them to synchronize our experiences for the benefits of ourselves and the workers.

entries.zh: 我们应该促进民主进程。
entries.en: We should enhance the democratic process.

entries.zh: 着重提升幸福感、凝聚力和专业性。
entries.en: Emphasis on increased happiness, unity and specialists.

entries.zh: 我们必须将意识连接到一起。
着重提升幸福度、劳工产出和稳定度。
entries.en: Emphasis on increased happiness, worker output and stability.

entries.zh: 这种里程碑式的转变只能由社会上层的来理解和实施，以免在我们的臣民中产生混乱和分歧。当§Y[Species.GetNamePlural]§!被安装上政府分发的义体植入体时，我们获得了一个绝无仅有的探索这些芯片提供全新可能性的机会。\n\n我们应该为社会创造激烈的竞争，让我们的工人提升到全新的高度，还是应该利用起睡眠中闲置的计算能力呢？
entries.en: This monumental shift can only be understood and enacted by the upper echelon of society, lest it leads to confusion and disagreements within our subjects. While the §Y[Species.GetNamePlural]§! are fitted with their government-issued cybernetic implants, and we have a unique opportunity to explore untapped opportunities these chips now afford.\n\nShould we push for a society where fierce competition raises our workers to new heights or harness the idle computational power of the sleeping minds?

entries.zh: 随着政府批准的公司开始大量生产不断改进的生物芯片，我们必须决定以何种方式来利用好这一次令人难以置信的社会变革。\n\n我们是应该模仿优胜劣汰的自然选择，还是发掘沉睡中的大脑尚未开发的潜力?
entries.en: As government-sanctioned corporations churn out ever-improving biochips, we must make a decision on how to best utilize this incredible societal change.\n\nShould we mimic nature, where only the strongest survive, or nurture the untapped potential of the slumbering brain?

entries.zh: 不管是好是坏，人们都将有机会通过制造和分销的义体强化硬件来证明自己，让我们可以自由地考虑大局，并决定如何最大限度地利用这种不可预见的社会转变。\n\n我们是应该促使人们完成更高的生产配额，还是让他们在睡梦中为我们工作？
entries.en: For better or worse, the people will be allowed to prove themselves in manufacturing and distributing the cyber-augmentation hardware, freeing us to consider the big picture and how to make the most of this unforeseen societal shift.\n\nShould we push people to meet ever higher quotas, or instead, make them work for us in their sleep?

entries.zh: 让那些马屁精们为我们呕心沥血吧。
entries.en: Have the sycophants toil for us.

entries.zh: 着重以降低幸福度为代价提升生产力。
entries.en: Emphasis on increased production at the cost of happiness.

entries.zh: 强调利用派系获取额外资源。
entries.en: Emphasis on leveraging factions for extra resources.

entries.zh: 在我们的强化改造计划中出现了许多提升稳定性和控制力的机遇。在我们为政府生产植入体并在人口中广泛地安装的过程中，秘密地嵌入可以引导人口实现更高生产力的算法可谓小菜一碟。\n\n我们可以通过在个人植入体中添加监控和后门程序来增加监视能力，或者我们可以安装代码，让我们§Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!光芒四射的人格影响大众。
entries.en: Several opportunities to increase stability and control have appeared within our augmentation program. As we manufacture government-issued implants and install them across our population, secretly installing algorithms to guide the population toward a preferred outcome would be easy.\n\nWe could increase our surveillance coverage by adding monitoring and backdoor tools to personal implants, or we could install code that allows our §Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!'s radiant personality to influence the masses.

entries.zh: 我们的合作伙伴公司已经准备好在社会范围内制造、分发和安装义体植入体，而即将到来的固件更新为我们提供了一个独特的机会。\n\n我们可以在个人强化硬件中秘密嵌入监控工具，这样就能找出有问题的人，或者可以创造一个人格覆写函数，将§Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!的意志烙印在大众的心中。
entries.en: Our partner corporations are ready to manufacture, distribute, and install cybernetic implants on a societal scale, and an upcoming firmware update provides us with a unique opportunity.\n\nWe could include hidden surveillance tools to personal augmentation hardware, allowing us to root out problematic individuals. Alternatively, we can create a personality override function that imprints the will of our §Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§! the masses.

entries.zh: 综合医院、街角商店和骇客群体现在正准备分发并在大众身上安装义体植入体。但是，没有必要把我们的权力如此完全地分散到这项令人兴奋的新技术上。\n\n我们可以提供客订化的植入体修改，把秘密监视工具隐藏其中，以对有问题的个人进行密切关注，或者我们可以安装人格覆盖算法，让我们§Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§!的意志在潜意识中引导人民走向伟大。
entries.en: General hospitals, corner shops, and hacker communities are now ready to distribute and install cybernetic implants on the populace. But there is no need to decentralize our power over this new and exciting technology so wholly.\n\nWe could provide custom implant modifications, with our own covert surveillance tools hidden within, to be able to keep tabs on problematic individuals. Alternatively, we could install personality-overriding algorithms that will allow the will of our §Y[Ruler.GetTitle]§! to subconsciously guide our people towards greatness.

entries.zh: 在个人植入体中藏入监视工具。
entries.en: Hide surveillance tools in personal implants.

entries.zh: 着重于帝国的稳定性和犯罪率降低。
entries.en: Emphasis on empire stability and crime reduction.

entries.zh: 着重于劳工产出和强制迁移。
entries.en: Emphasis on worker production and resettlement.

entries.zh:
政府已有效地调配了庞大的资源来进行人口的强化。政府批准的强化改造中心日夜不停地安装，并指导人们如何正确地使用、维护植入体。

现在的问题是，植入体的实际价值是应该集中在增强我们已经令人印象深刻的领导力上，还是作为下属娱乐和分散注意力的一种手段。

为我们的皇室制造最高质量的植入体可以让我们的领导层得以在代际保存知识，不可估量地提高稳定性。或者帝国可以提升首都的地位，让义体强化的运动员在这里参与最极端的体育盛事。
entries.en:
The government has deployed its vast resources to augment the population efficiently. Sanctioned augmentation centers have been installing implants day and night, and people have been instructed on proper usage and maintenance practices.

The question is whether the actual value of implants should be focused on enhancing our already impressive leadership or as a means to entertain and distract those who work under them.

Having the highest quality implants available to our dynasty could allow our leadership to preserve knowledge between generations, providing immeasurable stability. Or, the empire can elevate the capital and entertain with cybernetically enhanced athletes participating in state-of-the-art bloodsport events.

entries.zh:
官方批准的公司正在执行着操作指令。所有的人口都以义体植入体进行了强化，并准备好了以前所未有的效率提供服务。

现在的问题是应该将植入体的实际价值集中在哪里。

为我们的皇室制造最高质量的植入体可以让我们的领导层得以在代际保存知识，不可估量地提高稳定性。或者帝国可以提升首都的地位，让义体强化的运动员在这里参与最极端的体育盛事。
entries.en:
Officially sanctioned corporations have performed within operational directives. The entire population has been augmented with cybernetic implants and is ready to serve more efficiently than ever before.

The question now is where the actual value of implants should be focused on.

Having the highest quality implants available to our dynasty could allow our leadership to preserve knowledge between generations, providing immeasurable stability. Or, the empire can elevate the capital and entertain with cybernetically enhanced athletes participating in state-of-the-art bloodsport events.

entries.zh: 尽管有许多帝国官员持保留意见，但义体植入体的去中心化分配安装已经取得了成功。各个星球上的小诊所一直在不知疲倦地努力强化改造我们的人口。\n\n现在的问题是植入体的真正价值应该集中在什么方面。我们可以让统治者的知识储存在代际植入体中，或者为大众提供前所未见的义体人体育盛事。
entries.en: Despite numerous reservations from imperial officials, decentralized distribution and installation of cybernetic implants has been successful. Multiple small clinics across our worlds have been working tirelessly to enhance our population.\n\nThe question now is where the actual value of implants should be focused. This could mean preserving imperial knowledge within intergenerational implants or providing the masses with cyborg bloodsport, the likes that have never before been viewed by any ocular implant.

entries.zh: 着重于首都星球的生产力和幸福度。
entries.en: Emphasis on capital planet productivity and happiness.

entries.zh: 庞大而徒劳的政府植入体计划即将完成，这为我们带来了进一步扩大与这一前所未有的产品发布相关的收入来源的机会。我们的分析团队提出了两种潜在的收入来源，两者都有各自的风险和回报。\n\n政府是否应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
entries.en: The expansive yet ineffectual government implant program nears completion, presenting us with an opportunity to further expand revenue sources related to this unprecedented product launch. Our analytics team is proposing two potential sources of income, both with their own risks and rewards.\n\nShould the government require the inclusion of advertising in all future ocular implants, or mandate regular upgrades for the augmented population?

entries.zh:
得益于我们高度优化的企业基础设施，植入体的生产和安装与预期一样高效。这些新型植入体实际上带来了无穷无尽的商机。

其中有两条特别有前途的途径。虽然相互排斥，但两种方案的利润率都很高。

问题是，我们应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
entries.en:
Implant production and installation is as efficient as expected from our highly optimized corporate infrastructure. The business opportunities of these new implants are practically endless.

Two particularly promising avenues present themselves. While mutually exclusive, both predict stellar profit margins.

The question is, should we require the inclusion of advertising in all future ocular implants, or mandate regular upgrades for the augmented population?

entries.zh: 不出所料，义体件杂乱无章的“公共”植入正走向一个仁慈的结尾。我们现在还有机会影响这项有前途的新技术的发展方向，并在此过程中提高我们的产品利润率。\n\n应该要求在未来所有的视觉植入体中包含广告，还是要求对强化人口进行定期升级?
entries.en: Unsurprisingly, the haphazard "communal" implementation of cyberware is coming to its merciful end. We now have the opportunity to influence the direction of this promising new technology, raising our product margins in the process.\n\nShould advertisements be included in all future ocular implants, or would it be better to mandate a continuous upgrade cycle for software and wetware?

entries.zh: 设计广告支持的视觉植入体原型。
着重提升贸易额并降低商业机会的成本。
entries.en: Emphasis on increased trade and decreased economic opportunity costs.

entries.zh: 着重于生产力议程、谍报和舒适度维护费。
entries.en: Emphasis on productivity agendas, espionage and amenity upkeep.

entries.zh: 一种非法植入模组正在员工中广为传播，它可以刺激大脑产生任意的神经递质。这将会有广泛的用途，例如灌输强烈的快乐或者增强疼痛耐受性。从这些非法植入物中逆向工程出一个稳定的版本需要大量的投资，而且这种刺激的效果必将逐渐减退。\n\n我们是应该将这种非法植入体重新包装为商业化的版本，还是仅仅对其使用进行规范？
entries.en: An underground implant mod is spreading amongst the workforce that stimulates the brain to produce neurotransmitter chemicals at will. This has a wide array of uses from instilling intense pleasure to increasing pain tolerance. Reverse-engineering a stable version out of the illegal implant would require substantial investments, and the stimulating effects are bound to wear off eventually.\n\nShould we create a commercial version, repackage the underground prototype, or merely regulate their use?

entries.zh: 设计一种稳定的植入体。
越来越多的公司要求在工作期间的所有经验必须储存在义体大脑中的特殊区域，在工作以外的时候不得访问。\n\n他们声称，这种功能只会在高度机密的任务中使用，以避免商业窃密。有一些甚至要求雇员在工作中屏蔽个人经验，以避免个人道德对生产力造成干扰。
entries.en: More and more companies require that all experiences during office hours are stored in a cyberbrain memory area inaccessible outside work.\n\nThey claim to use this functionality only with highly confidential tasks to prevent corporate espionage. Some even require employees to wall off their private experiences at work to prevent personal ethics interfering with productivity.

entries.zh: 人们必须能完全掌控自己。
把工作忘在公司里是为健康着想。
entries.en: It is healthy to leave work at the office.

entries.zh: 随着义体件在我们的生活中愈发根深蒂固，盈利模式的变化将极大地影响整个社会。近来，植入体制造商将一些基本功能限制在订阅模式中成为了一种潮流。如果忘记付款，义体躯干可能会突然被锁定、视力可能会消失。消费者权益组织正在敦促我们出台措施阻止这种现象。
entries.en: With cyberware being so engrained in our lives, changes in monetization models affect our entire society dramatically. The recent trend has implants manufacturers lock essential functionalities behind a subscription model. Miss a payment and suddenly, your cyberlimbs lock up, and your optics turn off. Consumer organizations are urging us to put a stop to these practices.

entries.zh: 买不起就别用，有的时候找找自己的原因。
entries.en: If they can't afford it, they shouldn't buy it.

entries.zh: 将订阅限制在非关键功能上。
entries.en: Limit the subscriptions to non-critical functions.
Splendid idea! Double down on it.

entries.zh: 我们禁止义体件生产商用付费订阅来锁定植入体功能。
entries.en: We prevented cyberware producers from locking implant features behind subscription paywalls.

entries.zh: 我们禁止义体件生产商用付费订阅来锁定核心植入体功能。
entries.en: We prevented cyberware producers from locking core implant features behind subscriptions paywalls.

entries.zh: §Y$trait_cybernetic$§!物种物种增加以下修正：\n$t$幸福度：§R-5%§!\n$t$['concept_planet_traders']$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$：§G+25%§!
entries.en: Adds the following modifiers to the §Y$trait_cybernetic$§! species trait:\n$t$Happiness: §R-5%§!\n$t$$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_traders']: §G+25%§!

entries.zh: §Y$trait_cybernetic$§!物种物种增加以下修正：\n$t$幸福度：§R-5%§!\n$t$['concept_planet_traders']$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$：§G+50%§!
entries.en: Adds the following modifiers to the §Y$trait_cybernetic$§! species trait:\n$t$Happiness: §R-5%§!\n$t$$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_traders']: §G+50%§!

entries.zh: 义体件工程师为我们想出了一种全新的商业机遇。只要稍微降低植入体的耐用度，我们就可以利用用户替换必要部件的刚需来显著地提升利润。\n\n通过在日常磨损最频繁的部分使用劣质生物合金，植入体会以对消费者伤害最小的方式发生故障，从而制造更换需求。
entries.en: Our cyberware engineers have come to us with an economic opportunity. With only a slight reduction of implant durability, we could generate a substantial increase in profits as users will have to replace essential parts.\n\nBy using an inferior bio-alloy in the sections experiencing most of the usual wear and tear the implants should fail in a manner that minimizes harm to the consumer, but require replacement.

entries.zh: 我们不会向公民提供低质量的零件！\n\n
entries.en: We will not provide our citizens with low-grade components!\n\n

entries.zh: 真棒。开始生产更“轻薄”的义体件吧。
没错！再顺势涨一波价吧。
entries.en: Yes! Coordinate it with a price hike as well.

entries.zh: 利用这些数据来加速义体化进程。
entries.en: Use this data to improve our cyberization efforts.

entries.zh: 我们故意选择为公民提供劣质义体部件，这意味着他们必须更频繁地购买替换件。
entries.en: We have intentionally chosen to supply our citizens with inferior cybernetic components meaning that they have to buy replacements more often.

entries.zh: 我们持续创新并改进义体部件，让安装流程变得更加简单快捷。
entries.en: We have kept innovating and improving on our cybernetic components leading to a quicker and simpler install process.

entries.zh: 似乎公民们听见了我们敲的小算盘。\n\n现在整个大街小巷都是愤怒的[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，控诉着我们最近对义体件质量和价钱的调整。他们强烈要求我们改回去。
entries.en: It seems that our citizens have discovered our obsolescence initiative.\n\nThe streets are filled with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] who are outraged at the recent changes we have made to cyberware quality and cost. They are clamoring for us to revert these changes.
Alright, it was a little too greedy.
Say what? WE CANNOT HEAR YOU!

entries.zh: 我们的公民因最近义体件的涨价和质量下滑而陷入暴乱。
entries.en: Our citizens are rioting about our recent cyberware price hike and quality drop.

entries.zh: 监护人希望能通过幼体大脑中的植入体对他们的孩子进行更多的控制。对运动功能的接管目前仅限于警方使用，但有些人希望把这种权力也授予孩子的监护人。\n\n尽管这很明显违背了身体自主权，但许多其他方式的家长控制已经得到允许。替代方案是允许一些有限的控制，例如让行为不良的孩子减慢速度或降低音量。
entries.en: With brain implants installed in infants, caretakers are asking for more control over their children. The ability to take over motor functions is currently reserved for enforcers, but some want to extend these rights to parental guardians as well.\n\nWhile this is a clear violation of bodily autonomy, several other forms of parental coercion are already permitted. The alternative would be to permit limited control, such as slowing down or reducing the volume level of the misbehaving child.

entries.zh: 还是仅限执法者使用远程躯体控制功能。
entries.en: Leave remote body control to enforcers.

entries.zh: 在义体大脑植入体方面的发展给予了我们一个诱人的机遇。比起又主观又缓慢的教学方法，我们可以将关键的知识直接在大脑之间传输。该过程需要无菌的实验室环境，因此无法进行大规模应用。接收到的信息也会部分覆盖掉接收者的同类别记忆。\n\n最有影响的应用方式包括在科学家之间共享知识。这可以抵消来自义体化过程的一些工程学研究负担，或者将重点放在其他领域。
entries.en: The development of the cybernetic brain implants gives us an enticing opportunity. Instead of relying on subjective and slow teaching methods, we could transfer key knowledge directly from one brain to another. This requires sterile laboratory conditions, and thus would not be exploitable in large scale. The received information also overwrites parts of the recipient's own memories of a similar kind.\n\nThe most impactful application would involve knowledge sharing between scientists. This could offset some of the engineering debt from the cyberization process or be focused on other areas.

entries.zh: 让每个人保管好自己的思维。

在许多[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]愉快地用现成的义体来强化日常生活和人际关系的同时，越来越多的多配偶家庭转而使用带有定制硬件的私人网络。这些家庭群体选择生活在量身定制的隔离中，以独特的亲密感分享彼此的感受和经历。\n\n有社会福利团体和学者称赞这种现象，认为这种对人际关系和家庭纽带的客订化强化改造可以造福所有人。但也有人对这样的避世隐居产生了担忧，甚至认为这种行为可能导致个体在这种迷你的“爱情完形”中迷失自我。
entries.en: Whereas many [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have gladly augmented their everyday lives and relationships using off-the shelf cybernetics, a growing number of multiple-partner households in particular have instead taken to private networks with bespoke hardware. These domestic groups have chosen to live in tailor-made isolation, sharing each other's feelings and experiences with unique intimacy.\n\nSome social welfare groups and scholars applaud this phenomenon, suggesting everyone could benefit from custom augmentation of relationships and family bonds. Others have raised concerns about such a retreat from wider society, with some even suggesting the practice may cause individuals to lose themselves in miniaturized 'love gestalts'.

entries.zh: 他们怎么爱、怎么生活我们管不着。
entries.en: How they choose to live and love is not our concern.

entries.zh: 我们会继续允许客订化硬件和私密数字空间。
entries.en: We will continue to allow access to custom hardware and private digital spaces.

entries.zh: 各类家庭亲密关系都可以使用定制的软件和强化功能来丰富他们的人际关系。
entries.en: Domestic partnerships of all kinds can enrich their relationships using bespoke software and augments.
Bring these families back into the fold.

entries.zh: 我们不鼓励定制强化改造，支持更严格的监管方案。
entries.en: We will discourage bespoke augmentation in favor of more strictly regulated solutions.

entries.zh: 通过加强对义体强化改造和软件的严格控制，限制家庭建立数字世外桃源。
entries.en: Stricter controls on cybernetic augmentation and software discourage households from erecting digital walled gardens.

entries.zh: 在整个[root.GetSpeciesAdj]历史上，外部亚文化一直如影随形。随着义体增强技术的出现，情况发生了变化：一些边缘群体开始对自己进行大刀阔斧的改造，以至于看起来根本不像是[root.GetSpeciesAdj]。尤其是年轻人，他们对高度定制的[root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural]、3D躯体艺术和其他装饰性附肢的渴望正在拉大代沟。\n\n支持者声称，他们正在拥抱更真实的自我。他们通过放弃[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的同质化维护自己生命的主观能动性。但越来越多的家长和社会专家反对这种观点，他们谴责这些人是要破坏我们社会的恶棍。
entries.en: Outsider subcultures have existed throughout [root.GetSpeciesAdj] history, but with the advent of cybernetic enhancements the situation has changed: fringe groups have begun altering themselves so radically as to appear non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj]. Youths in particular are straining generation gaps with their lust for heavily customized [root.GetSpeciesHandNamePlural], 3D body art, and other decorative appendages.\n\nProponents claim they are embracing their truer selves, and that by renouncing [root.GetSpeciesAdj] homogeneity they are simply asserting agency over their own lives. These views are not shared by a growing number of concerned parents and social pundits, who denounce such individuals as miscreants out to ruin our society.

entries.zh: 对身体修改实施更严格的规定。
entries.en: Implement stricter guidelines on body modding.

entries.zh: 这是暂时现象，会好起来的。
entries.en: This is just a phase. It will pass.

entries.zh: 这个社会的年轻人正在大刀阔斧地尝试新外貌。
entries.en: Young people in this society are boldly experimenting with their own image.

entries.zh: 我们从这些年轻人中也能悟到点东西。
entries.en: We might learn something from these young people.

entries.zh: 以一些反文化的躯体修改为例，这个社会正在针对新型美学强化改造进行自己外形上的实验。
entries.en: Following an example set by counter-cultural body modders, this society is experimenting on its own image with new types of aesthetic augmentation.

entries.zh: 成千上万的年轻人、活动家和艺术家聚集在一起，呼吁义体强化改造自由。抗议者有的从外表上看来是正常的[root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，也有的拥有定制肢体、重塑躯体，还有的看起来像是外星人。他们都在声援那些因在义体装饰方面的个人选择而面临歧视的[root.GetAdj]公民。
entries.en: Concerned youths, activists, and artists have gathered in their thousands to demand freedom of cybernetic augmentation. Protestors run the gamut from outwardly typical [root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to individuals with custom limbs, reshaped torsos, and other alien-looking forms. All proclaim solidarity with [root.GetAdj] citizens who face discrimination for their personal choices in cybernetic adornment.

entries.zh: 我们会继续营造一种集体主义义体氛围。
entries.en: We will continue to foster a collectivist approach to cybernetics.

entries.zh: 最近关于通过义体强化改造自由表达利的抗议愈演愈烈了。
entries.en: Recent protests on the right to free expression through cybernetic augmentation have escalated.

entries.zh: 我们应该考虑他们的诉求。
我们将授予个人更多关于义体强化改造的选择自由。
entries.en: Individuals will be granted somewhat freer choice over cybernetic augmentation.

entries.zh: 近期的抗议使我们让渡了部分通过可见义体强化件进行自由表达的权利。
entries.en: Recent protests have ensured some rights to free expression through visible cybernetic augmentation.

entries.zh: 医疗工作者抱怨称，目前治疗那些使用着极端特殊义体强化体的病人时，面临着前所未有的奇怪困难。\n\n这些精心雕刻的个体即使只是一些小毛病，也大多需要使用特殊的治疗措施，如定制工具或剧烈拆卸等。此类干预措施的费用甚至超过了那些未修饰的非[root.GetSpeciesAdj]患者。
entries.en: Medical workers have raised complaints about the bizarre and unprecedented obstacles they now face when treating patients with radically unique cybernetic augments.\n\nMany of these elaborately-sculpted individuals require special treatment measures such as custom tools or drastic disassembly, even for minor ailments. The costs for such interventions far exceed those associated with unmodified, non-[root.GetSpeciesAdj] patients.

entries.zh: 批准这种稀奇古怪的东西真是大错特错。
entries.en: It was a mistake to allow so much customization.

entries.zh: 有一部分强化人口汇报称暴露在寒冷天气时会感受到疼痛。这种状况在§H[cold_planet.GetName]§!上格外严重，因为刺骨的严寒在那如同家常便饭一般。\n\n已知金属植入体在低温下确实令人不太舒服，但不至于产生这样的严重反应。这一情况影响到了我们的劳动力。
entries.en: A segment of our augmented population reports feeling pain when exposed to cold weather. The situation is particularly serious on §H[cold_planet.GetName]§!, where freezing temperatures are the norm.\n\nMetal implants are known to be uncomfortable in low temperatures, but should not be causing a reaction this severe. The situation is impacting our workforce.

entries.zh: 他们的痛苦跟我们没有关系。
entries.en: Their suffering is not our responsibility.

entries.zh: 对§Y$trait_cybernetic$§!物种特质添加如下修正：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$高山、极地、苔原宜居性：§R-20%§!
entries.en: Adds the following modifiers to the §Y$trait_cybernetic$§! species trait:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$Alpine/Arctic/Tundra Habitability: §R-20%§!

entries.zh: 在寒冷环境居住的人口汇报了各种与义体植入体有关的疼痛症状。通过临床实验可以让我们获得更多数据。
entries.en: Populations living in freezing climates report cases of severe pains related to cybernetic implants. A clinical trial will allow us to gather more data.

entries.zh: 临床实验无法确定义体件暴露于寒冷天气与受影响患者的年龄、性别、职业和植入体类型之间的明确相关性。\n\n有些医学专家认为这种疼痛是精神性的，治疗应该集中在止痛和行为疗法上。其他人则敦促我们不要低估这个问题，应该资助一个项目来推进治疗方案。
entries.en: Clinical trials could not establish a definitive correlation between the exposure of cyberware to cold weather and the age, sex, occupation and type of implants used by the affected patients.\n\nSome medical professionals argue the pain is psychosomatic, and treatment should be limited to painkillers and behavioral therapy. Others urge us to not underestimate the issue, and instead to fund a program to advance treatment options.

entries.zh: 痛什么痛，就是脑子有问题。
entries.en: Their pain is all in their heads.

entries.zh: 把受影响者迁移到温暖一些的星球上。
entries.en: Resettle the afflicted to a warmer planet.

entries.zh: 移除§Y$trait_cybernetic$§!物种特质的如下修正：$TABBED_NEW_LINE$高山、极地、苔原宜居性：§R-20%§!
entries.en: Removes the following modifiers to the §Y$trait_cybernetic$§! species trait:$TABBED_NEW_LINE$Alpine/Arctic/Tundra Habitability: §R-20%§!
Where Our Hearts Will Take Us

entries.zh: 我们的民族自古以来都是旅人、牧民和流浪者。有些人的旅行是到达目的地的一种手段，而我们的目的地就是旅行本身。身体强化改造使新的星球更加触手可及，但也使我们能够跟踪到那些太过离经叛道的人。就是说，并非所有人都对这种变化感到满意。\n\n越来越多的人开始篡改自己的植入体，通过脱离网络以保护自己的隐私。目前这仅仅是一个小众趋势，但它可能会带来麻烦。
entries.en: Our people have always been travelers. Nomads. Wanderers. While for some traveling is a means to reach a destination, for us the journey is a destination in itself. Body augmentation has made it easier to reach new worlds, but has also allowed us to track those who may stray too far. Not everyone is happy with this change.\n\nAn increasing number of people have been tampering with their implants, dropping themselves off the grid to preserve their privacy. For now it's a niche trend, but it could create trouble.

entries.zh: 他们没有错。禁止追踪科技。
这没什么可大惊小怪的。
entries.en: This is no cause for alarm.

entries.zh: 把不可追踪的植入体……卖给他们。
entries.en: Offer untraceable implants... for a price.

entries.zh: 遏制这些异见分子。保持追踪科技。
entries.en: Curb the dissenters. Tracking technology is here to stay.

entries.zh: 很难追踪，跑得到处都是。
entries.en: Hard to track. Easy to find everywhere.

entries.zh: 我们的人民崇尚自由，强烈反对任何形式的追踪科技。
entries.en: Our people cherish their freedom and vehemently oppose any kind of tracking technology.

entries.zh: 认知微处理器、增强的人工智能家教、促进神经可塑性再生的设计酶——这些都还只是为学龄前学生准备的。
entries.en: Cognitive micro-processors, enhanced A.I. tutors, designer enzymes to promote neuroplastic regeneration - and all of this just for preschool students.

entries.zh:
$cyber.855.intro.desc$

跟上科技发展的步伐让我们的国有教育计划背上了沉重的负担。然而那些只能依赖公共强化体的人和那些能享用最尖端科技的有钱人家之间的差距还在越变越大。

维持一个公平的制度将需要投入大量资源进行一项为期五年的计划。
entries.en:
$cyber.855.intro.desc$

Keeping pace with technological change has placed a heavy burden on our state-sponsored education programs. The performance gap is widening between those who rely on public augments and households that can afford cutting-edge technology.

Maintaining an equitable system will require a significant, five-year investment of resources.

entries.zh:
$cyber.855.intro.desc$

好的教育可以相当昂贵，而许多人感觉越来越难以跟上脚步了。然而那些能享用最尖端强化改造的有钱人家和只能依赖二手或者仿冒模块的人之间的差距还在越变越大。

为了避免进一步的社会分层，有必要对我们的教育系统进行一项重大的五年投资。
entries.en:
$cyber.855.intro.desc$

A good education can be expensive, and many are finding it increasingly difficult to keep pace. The performance gap is widening between households that can afford cutting edge augmentation and those that must rely on older, hand-me-down, or knock-off models.

To prevent further social stratification, it will be necessary to make a significant, five-year investment in our education system.

entries.zh: 教育就应该惠及所有人。
entries.en: Education must remain accessible to all.

entries.zh: 我们会发起一项五年计划，促生一种强韧且全面强化的教育系统。
entries.en: We will embark on a five-year program to promote a robust and fully-augmented education system.

entries.zh: 我们在教育强化件方面的投资取得了可观的回报。\n\n开放公众对高质量义体的获取创造了一种真正的学术精英统治，在这种秩序下，每个人——无论其社会阶层——都能充分发挥自己的潜力。这些好处在科学领域尤为明显，科研产出和创新水平全面提高。
entries.en: Our investment in educational augmentation has paid off handsomely.\n\nPublic access to high-quality cybernetics has created a true academic meritocracy in which everyone - no matter their social class - can achieve their full potential. The benefits are particularly noticeable in the sciences, where research output and innovation have improved across the board.

entries.zh: 高度受教育的强化人口是社会和物质进步的关键。
entries.en: A well-educated and fully augmented population is the key to social and material progress.

entries.zh: 事实证明，不动用公共资金去资助教育强化件的决定是明智的。\n\n我们的社会崇尚个人卓越。尽管对不断扩大的“社会鸿沟”的批评不绝于耳，但从学术竞争中却脱颖而出了一些全星系受教育程度最高、最具生产力的领袖。
entries.en: The decision to refrain from publicly funding educational augmentation has proven a wise one.\n\nOurs is a society that believes in individual excellence. Despite scattered criticism about the widening 'social divide', academic competition has resulted in some of the most highly-educated and productive leaders in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 在个人层面发展我们最有天赋的人防创造了一条培养品质杰出领袖的途径。
entries.en: Developing our best talent on an individual level has created a pipeline for leaders of exceptional quality.

entries.zh: “[Species.GetName]记录再突破”这样的标题在[Owner.GetAdjective]的体育新闻中已经屡见不鲜了。随着[GetAthletePlural]们竞相使用更新、更复杂的改装来超越彼此，运动能力的极限也在不断被突破。\n\n“强化体育”的粉丝们为这些结果欣喜若狂，但越来越多的铁杆爱好者呼吁应该单独设立强化运动员的项目。还有一些人希望限制参加团体比赛的改造人的数量，让纯天然的[GetAthletePlural]在聚光灯下还能占有一席之地。
entries.en: 'Another [Species.GetName] Record Broken' - this headline has become commonplace in [Owner.GetAdjective] sporting life. As [GetAthletePlural] race to outdo one another with newer and more sophisticated modifications, the limits of athletic performance are constantly being pushed.\n\nWhile fans of 'enhanced athletics' are ecstatic with the results, a growing number of hardcore devotees have called for enhanced individuals to be confined to a separate division. A final group instead wants to limit the amount of modified who compete in team events meaning that natural [GetAthletePlural] always have a place in the spotlight.

entries.zh: 未改造者们有过属于他们的时代了。
entries.en: The unmodified have had their time.

entries.zh: 鼓励改造运动员们推动创新。
entries.en: Encourage modified players to drive innovation.

entries.zh: 将强化运动员归到单独的联赛中。
entries.en: Relegate enhanced competitors to their own league.
Cap the amount of the modified [GetAthletePlural].

entries.zh: 通过鼓励改造运动员的体育赛事，我们可以对一些尖端的义体件进行实地测试。
entries.en: By promoting modified athletes in sports, we can field test bleeding edge cyberware.

entries.zh: 将“天然”和强化的运动员分开可以保证每个人都有公平的竞争环境。
entries.en: Separating 'natural' and augmented competitors ensures fair competition for everyone.

entries.zh: 限制改造运动员的数量可以保证每个队伍都有获胜的机会。
entries.en: Regulating the number of modified athletes ensures that every team has a real shot at success.

entries.zh:
§Y[sky_megacorp.GetName]§!向我们提供了一个利润丰厚的机遇。他们想为一种叫做“普乐快车”的全新提神饮料打广告。

可以将这种饮料的广告直接投射到我们的公民的视觉植入体中，只要一抬头就能看见。所产生的收入可以用于无数的公众项目。

尽管这种广告具有侵入性，但我们确信这种饮料本身应该是美味无害的。
entries.en:
The §Y[sky_megacorp.GetName]§! has offered us a lucrative opportunity. They wish to advertise their latest product, an energizing drink called Plasma Quench.

Ads for the drink will be projected straight into our citizens' ocular implants whenever they happen to glance up at the sky. The revenue generated could be used for any number of civic projects.

Despite the invasive nature of the ads, we have been assured that the beverage itself is delicious, and completely non-toxic.
The sky is not for sale!

entries.zh: §Y[sky_megacorp.GetName]§!又带来了一项新的关于全星系最受欢迎的能量饮料“普乐快车”的提案。鉴于目前对我们改造人口天空视角销售的成功，他们请求在现实世界的其他地方设置更多的广告。\n\n“[most_populous.GetName]就是最佳的广告投放地点！”一位[sky_megacorp.GetName]发言人如是说。毕竟，每个人都应该有机会获得这样令人难以置信的机会，这不是更公平吗？
entries.en: The §Y[sky_megacorp.GetName]§! has returned with a new offer regarding the galaxy's favorite energizing drink, Plasma Quench. Since the sale of our modified people's celestial view worked out so well, they have requested to put up additional advertisements in the physical world as well.\n\n"[most_populous.GetName] is the ideal advertisement location!" declared a [sky_megacorp.GetName] spokesperson. After all, is it not fairer that everyone should have access to such incredible opportunities?

entries.zh: 围绕§Y[most_populous.GetName]§!建造无数的巨大广告牌。
我们的数字化天空已经很足够了。
让我们的人民重见自由吧！
entries.en: Let our people see free again!

entries.zh: 售卖我们公民的视觉注意力是个绝妙的主意！
entries.en: Selling the virtual attention of our citizens was a great decision!

entries.zh: 该行星的精英决定售卖公民眼中的天空来赚取更多的资源。
entries.en: The elites of this planet chose to sell their citizens' sky to earn some extra resources.

entries.zh:
有了如此众多能够控制感官和情感体验的植入体，强化改造的个体现在更倾向投身虚拟活动，以此进行娱乐或者逃避现实。虽然忆痕艺术家理论上可以激发出任何情绪，但这种做法却已经出现了一些黑暗的转折。

忆痕俱乐部高价收购那些具有强烈情感体验的自录记忆，例如婚礼、交配仪式、自杀、袭击和谋杀等等。这一做法导致了犯罪率上升，犯罪分子不但会为了记忆犯罪，还会在这些创伤经历后窃取受害者的植入体。

我们应该如何应对与之相关的乱象?
entries.en:
With so many implants able to control sensory and emotional experiences, augmented individuals have turned to virtual life events as escapism and entertainment. While engram artists can theoretically stimulate any emotion, the practice has taken a dark turn.

Memory engram clubs are paying top credits for self-recorded, intensely emotional experiences such as weddings and mating rituals, but also suicides, assaults, and murders. This has caused an uptick in crime, as criminals are both recording themselves committing offenses as well as stealing victims' implants after a traumatic experience.

How should we handle this concerning craze?

entries.zh: 关停这项产业。这也太危险了。
entries.en: Shut down the industry. It's too dangerous.

entries.zh: 忆痕娱乐会变成一项创收的产业。
entries.en: Engram entertainment will be used as a source of income.

entries.zh: 把持有这种记录的统统抓起来。
entries.en: Jail anyone caught with such recordings.

entries.zh: 记录犯罪行为的个体将被绳之以法。
entries.en: Law enforcement will target those who record criminal behavior.

entries.zh: 听起来太颓废了。我喜欢。
所有形式的娱乐都会得到国家的认可。
entries.en: All forms of pleasure will be endorsed by the state.

entries.zh: 死亡的无限体验？多么神圣啊。
entries.en: The endless experience of death? How divine.

entries.zh: 这会增进我们死亡司祭的理解，从而更好地引导凡体先烈。
entries.en: This will allow our Death Priests to understand and guide the experiences of our Mortal Initiates.

entries.zh: 忆痕记录娱乐被定为违法，以避免可能的犯罪行为。
entries.en: Recorded engram entertainment was made illegal to avoid possible criminal behavior.

entries.zh: 在国家下场支持之后，忆痕娱乐开始风靡大街小巷。
entries.en: Recorded engram entertainment has become widespread after state endorsement.

entries.zh: 关于忆痕娱乐的新法律抑制了大众对这项服务的需求。
entries.en: The new laws around engram entertainment have put a damper on the demand for the service.

entries.zh: 我们的人民正在享受着忆痕娱乐带来的极致欢娱，直到下一个潮流取而代之为止。
entries.en: Our people are reveling the extreme joy entertainment provided by engram entertainment. At least until the next fad comes along.

entries.zh: 我们的死亡司祭现在可以亲身感受生死。这有助于他们对人们特别是凡体先烈的引导。
entries.en: Our Death Priests can now experience taking life and dying. This helps them guide the people, especially our Mortal Initiates.

entries.zh: 一位海军军校生泄露了机密信息，其愚蠢之举令人震惊。作为一名网络战斗模拟器的忠实粉丝，这位学员与其他玩家就我们驱逐舰上炮塔的旋转速度发生了争论。\n\n为了支持自己的说法，学员甚至上传了几张我们舰船的机密蓝图，这些文件很快传遍了全星系网络。尽管肇事者已被处理，但由于这一事件，内阁中有声音呼吁全面禁止网络游戏。
entries.en: In an appalling display of foolishness, a naval cadet has leaked classified information. A dedicated fan of networked combat simulators, the cadet got into an argument with other players about the angular velocity of the turrets on our destroyers.\n\nTo bolster their position, the cadet uploaded several classified blueprints of our ships, documents which quickly spread across the galactic network. Although the culprit has been dealt with, voices on the Council are calling for a wholesale ban on online gaming as a result of this incident.
It was time to modernize the fleet anyway.

entries.zh: 强化我们的网络安全措施。
内阁说得对，禁止电子游戏。
entries.en: The Council is right: ban the games.

entries.zh: 用互相矛盾的内容淹没那条信息。
entries.en: Drown the intel in conflicting reports.

entries.zh: 事情发生就是发生了。我们会加把劲让舰队更加现代化，这样一来泄露的蓝图就没什么用了。
entries.en: What's done is done. We will work to modernize our fleets and render the leaked schematics useless.

entries.zh: 为响应信息泄露，我们改进了安保条款。也就是说，游戏玩家并不会对国家安全造成威胁。对这种愚蠢的过失我们没必要反应过度。
entries.en: In response to the leak, we have updated our security protocols. This being said, gamers do not pose a threat to national security. There is no need to overreact to a foolish mistake.

entries.zh: 在增强运营安全的基础上，我们还进一步禁止了网络游戏。
entries.en: In addition to reinforcing our operational security, we have instituted a ban on networked gaming.

entries.zh: §Y星海共同体§!的全体成员获得§Y[Root.GetName]§!持续§Y720§!天的§H中等§!§Y军事§!情报。
entries.en: Every member of the §YGalactic Community§! gets §HMedium§! §YMilitary§! Intel on §Y[Root.GetName]§! for §Y720§! days.

entries.zh: §Y星海共同体§!的全体成员获得§Y[Root.GetName]§!持续§Y360§!天的§R低§!§Y军事§!情报。
entries.en: Every member of the §YGalactic Community§! gets §RLow§! §YMilitary§! Intel on §Y[Root.GetName]§! for §Y360§! days.

entries.zh: 该选项因我们已完成§Y密谋§!传统树而解锁。
entries.en: This option is available because we have completed the §YSubterfuge§! tradition tree.

entries.zh: 最新一代的感官义体件可以让用户屏蔽不必要的感觉。包括不受欢迎的气味、不得体的画面等等，一切都可以被淡化、掩盖，甚至完全从用户的感知中抹去。我们社会中较为保守的团体越来越担心这种审查制度会对我国公民的良知产生影响。
entries.en: The latest generation of sensory cyberware allows user to block out unwanted sensations. From unwelcome smells to unseemly pictures, everything can be toned down, masked, or even entirely erased from the user's perception. There are growing concerns amongst the more conservative groups of our society about the effects such censorship will have on the conscience of our citizens.

entries.zh: 我们必须面对生命的真实。
entries.en: We must face the truth of our lives.

entries.zh: 每个人都有权享受无知之福。
entries.en: Everyone has a right to blissful ignorance.

entries.zh: 美化性重渲染不错，但审查的风险就太大了。
entries.en: Cosmetic reshades are fine, censoring is risky.

entries.zh: 我们会安排好他们的感官的。
禁止使用可以阻挡现实生活元素的认知过滤器。无论何时都应该直面现实。
entries.en: People are not allowed to apply perception filters that would block out real life elements. The truth must be faced at all times.

entries.zh: 如果现实令人感到不适，为什么不干脆把那些不良元素屏蔽掉呢？没有必要去目睹犯罪、悲惨和偏见的画面。
entries.en: If reality makes you uncomfortable, why not simply block out the offending elements? You need not witness crime, misery or prejudice.

entries.zh: 我们允许人们使用植入体的认知重渲染功能。他们可以在单调的生活中注入灵动的色彩。
entries.en: We have allowed people to use perception reshades in their implants. With this, they can inject lively colors and effects in their otherwise drab existence.

entries.zh: 我们正在安排员工看待现实的方式。通过将政治异见信息和人物挡在我们忠诚公民的生活之外，就可以保护他们不受那些可能产生误导的人的影响。
entries.en: We are curating how our people perceive reality. By blocking out dissident messages and actors from the lives of our loyal citizens, we preserve them from those that would misguide them.

entries.zh: 最近，雄心勃勃的企业和地下运动的广告倾向于在用户的义体件中隐秘地植入信息。虚假记忆、选择性荷尔蒙反应和睡眠建议正变得司空见惯。忧心忡忡的政界人士向我们提出了这个关切，并主张禁止这些侵入性信息，或至少加以监管。
entries.en: A recent trend in advertisement for underground movements and ambitious corporations is to implant surreptitious messages in the user cyberware. Fake memories, selective hormonal reactions, and sleep suggestions are becoming commonplace. Concerned political actors have raised the issue with us and are advocating for a ban, or at least a regulation these invasive messages.
Use it to spread the faith.

entries.zh: 我们禁止通过义体件进行这种隐秘的潜意识信息传输。
entries.en: We have forbidden the practice of using insidious subliminal messaging through cyberware.

entries.zh: 我们允许通过义体件进行这种隐秘的潜意识信息传输。市场上一切都是公平的。
entries.en: We have allowed the practice of using insidious subliminal messaging through cyberware. All is fair on the market.

entries.zh: 潜意识骇入传讯：许可监管
我们向通过义体件进行这种隐秘的潜意识信息传输售发许可认证。
entries.en: We are selling licenses to allow the practice of using insidious subliminal messaging through cyberware.

entries.zh: 我们会使用潜意识骇入传讯技术来传播信仰。
entries.en: We are using insidious subliminal messaging through cyberware to spread our faith.

entries.zh: 最近，有几份机密文件被远程服务器非法下载。我们的安全人员坚持认为所有的主防火墙和二级防火墙都完好无损，到目前为止也没有外部网络攻击的证据。\n\n
entries.en: Recently, several classified documents were illegally downloaded by a remote server. Our security operatives are adamant that all primary and secondary firewalls remain intact, and so far there is no evidence of an external cyber attack.\n\n

entries.zh: $cyber.1255.intro$但结论无可逃避：我们中出了个叛徒，而且鉴于这些信息的敏感程度，他一定有着很高的权限。
entries.en: $cyber.1255.intro$The conclusion is inescapable: we have a leak, and given the sensitive nature of the stolen information, it must be someone with high-level clearance.

entries.zh: $cyber.1255.intro$但结论无可逃避：我们有漏洞——这个漏洞让我们接受开源义体强化件的决定受到质疑。
entries.en: $cyber.1255.intro$The conclusion is inescapable: we have a leak - one that casts our decision to embrace open-sourced cybernetic augmentation into doubt.

entries.zh: 为了找出漏洞，我们需要调查所有安装了义体植入体的人。这个过程很可能会比较……侵入性。
entries.en: To uncover the leak, we will need to investigate all those with cybernetic implants. The process is likely to be... intrusive.

entries.zh:
对义体安全漏洞的调查获得了结论。

我们已经锁定了一种强化件和一些政府高级官员，他们的神经学湿件遭到了入侵。外国特工对其进行操作，并强迫他们违背自己的意志行动，这些个体对上述事件没有任何记忆。

尽管我们已经知道了泄露的原因，但我们对究竟是谁——或什么东西——进行了窃密仍一筹莫展。然而，通过秘密向那些受影响的官员意识中植入错误信息，我们也许可以追溯到窃密源。
entries.en:
The investigation into our cyber security leak has concluded.

Certain augmented and high-level officials within the government have been targeted, their neurological wetware hacked. Manipulated by external agents and forced to act against their will, these individuals have no memory of the events in question.

Although we now know the cause of the leak, we are no closer to discovering who - or what - was ultimately responsible. However, by surreptitiously implanting false data into the minds of the affected officials, we may be able to trace the leak back to its source.

entries.zh: 当我们中的每一个人都可能是傀儡时，又怎么能指望人民对我们的领导有信心呢？
entries.en: How can we expect the people to have faith in our leadership when any one of us may be a puppet?

entries.zh: 这位领袖受到了损害，其神经学湿件被未知攻击源骇入了。
entries.en: This Leader is compromised, their neurological wetware hacked by an unknown source.

entries.zh: 随机数量的义体人领袖获得§Y$leader_trait_hacked$§!特质。
entries.en: A random number of Cyborg Leaders have gained the §Y$leader_trait_hacked$§! Trait.

entries.zh:
找到了。

藏身于本次史无前例网络攻击背后的犯罪分子已经被找到了。这些自称为“精神劫持者”的人除了制造混乱没有其他目的，他们能游刃有余地绕过我们的安全系统。虽然主犯已经被拘留，但我们仍然必须决定如何处理我们受侵害的官员。

最简单的解决方案是在受影响的植入体周围安装自定义防火墙。而还有一个更干净、但风险更大的选择是硬重启：通过进入上述领袖的基础认知功能，重新安装操作系统，期间这些领袖会被强制“关机”。
entries.en:
We have them.

The criminals behind the unprecedented cyber attacks have been found. With no goal other than the sowing of chaos, these self-proclaimed 'Mind Jackers' managed to circumvent our security systems with embarrassing ease. While the ringleaders are already in custody, we must still decide what to do with our compromised officials.

The simplest solution is to install a custom firewall around their affected implants. A cleaner, though more risky, option is a hard reboot: accessing their base cognitive functions, the leaders in question could be forcibly 'shut down' while a new operating system is installed.

entries.zh: 我们被贼惦记上了。建立防火墙。
entries.en: They're onto us. Build the wall.

entries.zh: 我们对入侵的官员的硬重启导致了一些意想不到的后果：虽然抹去了所有神经系统入侵的痕迹，但他们积累的一大部分知识和经验也随之而去。\n\n尽管遭遇挫折，但在“重新开始”的过程中，这些领袖表示自己在职业和个人方面都获得了深刻的新生。通过迫使我们采取如此激烈的措施，黑客们可能无意中帮了我们一个忙。
entries.en: The hard reboot of our compromised officials has resulted in some unexpected consequences: every trace of the neurological hack has been wiped clean, but so too has a great portion of their accumulated knowledge and experience.\n\nDespite this setback, in 'starting fresh' these leaders report deep feelings of professional and personal renewal. By forcing us to take such drastic measures, the hackers may have unintentionally done us a favor.

entries.zh: 移除具有§Y$leader_trait_hacked$§!特质领袖的所有§H负面特质§!。\n每移除一项特质造成§R300§!经验值的损失。
entries.en: Removes all §HNegative Traits§! from Leaders with the §Y$leader_trait_hacked$§! Trait.\nFor each Trait removed, §R300§! Experience will be lost.

entries.zh: 我们的意识安全了。\n\n湿件工程师成功地设计出了神经学防火墙。为了维持我们的集体安全，我们目前和未来的所有官员立刻安装上了这些程序。尽管这会对我们的领导阶层的基础认知功能造成影响，但这项工程也对数据安全科学带来了卓著的洞见。
entries.en: Our minds are safe.\n\nWetware engineers have successfully designed a neurological firewall. In order to maintain our collective security, the program will be immediately installed in all current and future officials. While this will have a detrimental impact on the base cognitive functionality of our leadership class, the project has provided significant insight into the science of data security.

entries.zh: 尽管可以抵御网络攻击，但我们领袖的学习效率下降了。
entries.en: While safe from cyber attacks, our leaders are less effective learners.

entries.zh: 所有义体人领袖移除§Y$leader_trait_hacked$§!特质，并添加§Y$leader_trait_firewalled$§!特质。
entries.en: Removes the §Y$leader_trait_hacked$§! Trait and Applies the §Y$leader_trait_firewalled$§! Trait to all Cyborg leaders.

entries.zh: 民主过程是这个社会的基础，显然只有加强这个基础才是明智的选择。新的义体使我们能够对或大或小的所有社会问题进行投票，为个人提供前所未有的表达意见的机会。这带来了难以想象的数据财富和无穷的可能性。
entries.en: The democratic process is what this society has been built on. It only makes sense to strengthen this foundation. Our new cybernetics enable us to cast our vote on all societal matters big or small, affording the individual unprecedented opportunities to express their opinion. The wealth of data this brings is unimaginable and the possibilities are boundless.

entries.zh: 公开地向其他的§Y[Species.GetNamePlural]§!同胞传播自己的想法看似是一种糟糕前景。但最初的震惊很快就会被对周围环境的自信和确定感所取代。我们知道身边人在做什么，反之他们也一样。不需要言语，只需一动念头，交流就能瞬间完成。为了保护这种清晰的思维，义体大脑的情绪功能被指令关闭以免淹没重要信息。
entries.en: Openly broadcasting your thoughts to your fellow §Y[Species.GetNamePlural]§! is a harrowing prospect. But the initial shock is soon replaced with a sense of confidence and certainty over one's surroundings. We are aware of what the person next to us does, and they are aware of us. Communication happens instantly without words with a mere thought. To protect this clarity of mind, the cyberbrain has been instructed to nullify emotions lest they drown what is important.

entries.zh: 尽管经过了无数次的磋商、投票和热烈的讨论，国家仍未就义体强化社会的问题做出决定。为了避免使这个过程演变成一场分裂的争论，领导层必须介入。\n\n我们可以利用这个机会修改义体，为民主过程服务，或者采取更激进的方法，让人们通过他们的义体件分享想法。后者还需要抑制义体大脑基本情绪，以防止个人强烈的自发想法扰乱其周围的环境。
entries.en: Despite endless consultation, rounds of voting and lively discourse, the nation remains undecided on the matters of cyber-enhanced society. Before the process devolves into a divisive argument, the leadership must step in.\n\nWe can use this opportunity to modify our cybernetics to serve the democratic process or take the more radical approach where people share their thoughts via their cyberware. The latter would also require the cyberbrain to suppress base emotions to prevent forceful spontaneous thoughts from disrupting one's immediate surroundings.

entries.zh: 将义体脑互联以共享经验。
很显然，大众都想要出人头地、与其他人一争高下。我们迎合这种超竞争行为的方式是设立一种游戏化的系统，用社会流动性和小饰品的承诺来换取生产力的提高，也能很好地满足他们的愿望。
entries.en: It has become clear that the population wishes to stand out and joust against one another. Our plans to support this hyper-competitive behavior with a gamified system, which promises social mobility and minor trinkets in exchange for increased productivity, will suit their desire well.

entries.zh: 人们所能感受到的集体意识比个人的社会流动性更重要。因此，我们将挖掘睡眠增强大脑的潜力，而不是利用竞争本能。将计算能力通过义体上行链路无线连接到基站，在对象的整个休息阶段中下达计算任务。
entries.en: That the people feel a sense of community is more important than individual social mobility. So, instead of leveraging competitiveness, we will tap into the potential of the sleeping augmented brain. Its computational power is connected wirelessly to a base station via a cybernetic uplink, which feeds computational tasks to the subject throughout the rest phase.

entries.zh: 我们的国民拒绝对社会应变得更具竞争性或是协作性的问题表明立场。而作为他们的上级，我们现在将为他们决定最好的方案。\n\n我们可以创建一个高度竞争性的游戏化系统，在这个系统中，比你的同行表现得更好可能会为职业生涯带来上升机会，或者通过义体上行链路利用整个社区的计算能力，将他们的大脑在沉睡中连接到我们的服务器农场。
entries.en: Our subjects have failed to make a stand either towards a more competitive or communal society. As their superiors, We will now decide the best course of action for them.\n\nWe can either create a highly competitive gamified system where performing better than your piers might yield an upward trajectory for their careers or instead harness the computational power of the entire community via a cybernetic uplink to connect their sleeping brains into our server farms.

entries.zh: 让他们互相争风吃醋吧。
entries.en: Let them fight to curry favor.
Make them work while they sleep.

entries.zh: §Y[Species.GetAdj]§!民众正在逐渐接受一个可以用强化体以全新的方式表达自我的世界。\n\n但这种宽容只是表象，植入体的内增强监控算法现在正在监视着每一个人，在大脑突触连接的那一刻就能发现不当的想法。
entries.en: The §Y[Species.GetAdj]§! people are embracing a world where the augmented can express their identity in brand new ways.\n\nBut the leniency is only a facade, as enhanced surveillance algorithms within the implant are now monitoring every individual, detecting dissident thoughts the moment brain synapses connect.

entries.zh: 危难当前，唯有团结。每一个通过义体增强的§Y[Species.GetAdj]§!都在为更美好的未来而奋斗，并相信身边的人也都会这样做。\n\n具有钢铁般意志和光辉人格的§Y[Ruler.GetName][Ruler.GetTitle]§!会带领我们的人民向前进，他们大可对此放心。
entries.en: There is strength in numbers and its unifying momentum in the face of adversity. Every cyber-enhanced §Y[Species.GetAdj]§! fights towards a better future together, trusting the person next to them to do the same.\n\nOur people can rest secure in the knowledge that the radiant personality of their iron-willed §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetName]§! guides them onwards.

entries.zh: 当人民继续在十字路口犹豫不决时时，我们的§Y[Ruler.GetName][Ruler.GetTitle]§!必须抓住强化改造所提供的这一独特机会并作出决定。\n\n应该让我们的人民保持一定的自由意志，以植入体进行监控，或是要让他们完全由领袖光芒四射的意志所引领。
entries.en: As the people continue to waver in the crossroads, our §Y[Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetName]§! must seize this unique opportunity offered by the augmentations and make a decision.\n\nShould our people be allowed some personal freedoms while monitoring them through their implants, or have them influenced by the will of their leader's radiant personality?

entries.zh: 给他们监视下的适度自由。
皇帝下诏要求我们把精力集中在王朝本身。一块特殊的§Y$r_the_rulerchip$§!会被植入每一位未来的统治者，以记录并转移他们作为§Y[root.GetName]§!的[root.GetRulerTitle]期间的经验。\n\n随着$r_the_rulerchip$的代代相传，其蕴含的丰富经验将成为我们社会的重要记录。另外，我们也可以利用人民的知识来增益领袖。
entries.en: The imperial seat has decreed our efforts be focused on the dynasty itself. A special §Y$r_the_rulerchip$§! will be implanted on all future rulers to record and transfer their experiences as the [root.GetRulerTitle] of the §Y[root.GetName]§!. This relic chip will then be transferred to the heir at the time of the ruler's passing.\n\nAs the $r_the_rulerchip$ is passed on through generations, its vast library of experiences will become the foundational record of our society. We can also leverage our population's learnings for our leaders' benefit.

entries.zh: 为了缓解我们帝国公民的辛劳，必须在§Y[root.Capital.GetName]§!/“建立一座宏伟的§Y$building_cyberdome$§!。它将会成为新式义体运动的举办场所，强化过的运动员们将为了我们的青睐和景仰争奇斗艳。目睹如此尖端的竞争无疑能激起大众对§Y[root.GetName]§!的崇拜之情。\n\n此外，这些景象还可以通过神经广播直接传达到全帝国的义体大脑中，驱使热情的人群前往[root.Capital.GetName]，亲身体验这种行为的原始刺激。
entries.en: To offer our imperial citizens respite from their toil, a great §Y$building_cyberdome$§! must be built on §Y[root.Capital.GetName]§!. It will serve as the glorious venue for new kinds of cybersports, where augmented athletes compete for our favor and admiration. Witnessing such fierce competition will surely invigorate the masses and their admiration for the §Y[root.GetName]§!.\n\nFurthermore, these spectacles can be neurocasted straight into the cyberbrain, which will compel the exuberant crowds to travel to [root.Capital.GetName] and experience the primal thrill of the action firsthand.

entries.zh: 我们社会在义体领域的发展走到了一个岔路口。我们可以致力于造福少数人或是大众上。无论作何选择都将为§Y[root.GetName]§!带来好处。\n\n开发一种专业的植入体可以让我们将[root.GetRulerTitle]的经验传承给子嗣。而着力发展强化义体运动和广播科技则可以让我们可以在[root.Capital.GetName]的首都举办盛大的赛事活动。
entries.en: Our societal advancement in the field of cybernetics is at a crossroads. We can either concentrate our efforts for the benefit of the few or the many. Both would ultimately serve the §Y[root.GetName]§! well.\n\nDeveloping a specialized implant would allow us to transfer the experiences of the [root.GetRulerTitle] to the heir. Emphasis on augmented cybersports and broadcasting technologies would allow us to organize magnificent events on our capital of [root.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 在首都举办义体运动并进行广播。
entries.en: Host and broadcast cybersports at the capital.

entries.zh: §Y[Species.GetAdj]§!焦点小组对他们的新眼部植入物反应积极。我们的分析部门认为，广告效果显著提高，整个产品组合的销售额有望大幅增长。这为即将到来的完整产品发布展示了巨大的潜力。\n\n义体时代已经来临，我们已经做好充分准备以一种全新的企业战略来加以利用。
entries.en: §Y[Species.GetAdj]§! focus groups are responding positively to the their new ocular implants. Our analytics department suggests a remarkable surge in ad effectiveness and a promising bump in sales throughout our entire portfolio. This showcases immense potential for the forthcoming full product launch.\n\nThe age of cybernetics is here, and we are fully poised to capitalize it with a renewed corporate strategy.

entries.zh: 我们对整体自我完善的承诺引起了大众的共鸣。\n\n关注社会经济问题密切地贴合我们企业的愿景，这可以确保必要植入体不断地推陈出新。
entries.en: Our commitment to holistic self-improvement is resonating with the general population.\n\nAttending to socio-economic concerns aligns with our corporate vision, ensuring that new generations of must-have implants are introduced on a constant basis.

entries.zh: 考虑到义体技术给社会带来的巨大变化，普通消费者会纠结于方向的选择或许也就不足为奇了。我们应该将个体差异作为标准，还是更应该关注集体福祉?\n\n这个关键而无与伦比的决定必然会产生深远的影响，但优柔寡断就会损失利益；必须尽快做出抉择。
entries.en: Given the vast changes that cybernetic technology have introduced to society, perhaps it should come as no surprise that the average consumer is torn about which direction to take. Will individual differentiation become our standard, or should focus be placed on the collective well-being?\n\nThis pivotal and unparalleled decision is sure to have far-reaching consequences, but indecision is the death of profit; a choice must be made.

entries.zh: 推出支持广告功能的植入体。

蜂巢思维需要优越的躯体。有了义体植入体，我们就可以对工蜂进行改进、强化、重塑。
是时候超越我们生物学的极限了。

§Y次月获得植入体的人口数§!：§G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!
entries.en:
A Hive Mind needs superior bodies. With cybernetic implants, our drones can be perfected, enhanced, remodelled.
It is time to transcend the limits of our biology.

§YPops to receive implants next month§!: §G[From.GetCyberPopsPerMonth]§!

entries.zh: 我们的身体将变为义体，这是一种有机与机械的完美融合。
entries.en: Our bodies will become cybernetic, a perfect fusion between organic and machine.

entries.zh: 我们必须自行设计安装义体植入体，来进行自我转变。
entries.en: We must design cybernetic implants, install them, and transform ourselves.

entries.zh: 影响进行中的§Y义体意识变迁§!。
旧的植入体可以装给新的工蜂。
没有什么是神圣的，也没有什么会被浪费。
entries.en: Nothing is sacred. Nothing is wasted.

entries.zh: 新工蜂在新生期间装备了植入体。
entries.en: New drones are equipped with implants during spawning.

entries.zh: 植入物是逐步安装的，以减少对还在发育的工蜂的伤害。
entries.en: Implants are installed gradually, reducing damage to underdeveloped drones.

entries.zh: 所有个体识别都要严令禁止。
entries.en: Every personal identifier is strictly forbidden.
Drones are allowed to express their individuality.

entries.zh: 送给我们最好的工蜂以最珍贵的礼物：自我意识。
entries.en: To our best drones, the rarest gift: a sense of self.

entries.zh: 每个工蜂都是一个个体。每个想法，都是集体思维的新视角。蜂巢中无数意志的集合会远超每个部分的简单加和。
entries.en: Every drone, an individual. Every thought, a new perspective for the collective to consider. Countless minds form a Hive far greater than the sum of its parts.

entries.zh: 所有的偏移都得到纠正，所有的异常都得到了限制，所有的不团结都被重新整合。蜂巢思维获得了绝对的掌控：这个共同的意识拥有无数的躯体可以执行其意志。
entries.en: Every deviation has been corrected, every anomaly curbed, every disunity rectified. The Hive Mind's control is absolute: one shared consciousness, and countless bodies to execute its will.

entries.zh: 一个坚决的意识贯彻意志的速度可以比光还快。
entries.en: The will of a determined mind moves faster than the speed of light.

entries.zh: 义体植入体可以自动管理我们工蜂的增强性药物以提高其性能。
entries.en: Cybernetic implants automatically administer boosting drugs to our drones, increasing performance.

entries.zh: 这项法令将为我们的巨型结构工程分配额外资源，加快星系内新结构的建设速度。
entries.en: This Edict allocates additional resources to our Mega-Engineering program, speeding up the construction of new galactic structures.

entries.zh:
当在思考增强改造的本质时，我们也发现自己其实正在探索自己的愿望。

义体是达到目的的一种手段：它是一种优化我们的身体以更好地执行意志的方法。无限的强化改造是可能的，每一个强化体都将带来新的优势，但也带来了新的要求。机械肢体很重，网络大脑需要更多的能量，精密的部件也需要不断的维护。在通往完美的道路上，必须做出抉择。

要超越[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]局限、让机械化的[owner.GetSpeciesHandName]触及寰宇，我们的雄心壮志到底要聚焦何处？
entries.en:
As we ponder the nature of augmentation, we find ourselves exploring our aspirations.

Cyberization is a mean to an end: a way to optimize our bodies to better execute our will. Endless forms of augmentation are possible, each bringing new strengths, but also needs. Mechanical limbs are heavy, cyberbrains require more energy, and delicate components require constant maintenance. On the road to perfection, choices must be made.

What is the focus of our ambition, the one goal that requires transcending the limits of the [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] to stretch a metallic [owner.GetSpeciesHandName] across the sky?

entries.zh: 专注于提高我们工蜂智能的研究。
entries.en: Focus research on making our drones more intelligent.

entries.zh: 专注于让我们的工蜂成为战争工具的研究。
entries.en: Focus research on making our drones into tools of war.

entries.zh: 专注于让我们的工蜂更高产的研究。
entries.en: Focus research on making our drones more productive.

entries.zh: 随着闲散的思考变成具体的计划，一种迫切的需求出现了：一个专门用于实验以及测试、建造义体原型的空间。\n\n我们将建立一座$building_augmentation_center$，这样我们就可以把我们的[Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed]拆开，用金属和梦想重新编织在一起。
entries.en: As idle musings turn into concrete plans, a pressing need arises: a space devoted to experimentation, where cybernetic prototypes can be tested and built.\n\nWe shall raise an $building_augmentation_center$, so we may rend our [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] apart and reknit it together with metal and dreams.

entries.zh: 是时候开始建设未来了。
entries.en: Time to start building our future.

entries.zh: §R需要采取行动：§!\n建造一个£building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center']以恢复§Y$situation_cyberization_hive$§!局势。
entries.en: §RAction required:§!\nBuild an £building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center'] to resume the §Y$situation_cyberization_hive$§! situation.

entries.zh: 我们的义体研究已经产出了多个有前途的义体原型供我们选择。初步结果表明，一些原型机在体力方面表现出色，而另一些则更适合精密工作。每一种都有其长处和局限性，没有一种具有压倒性优势。\n\n我们意识中浮现出一个令人生畏的提议：我们可以让子个体变得多样化、根据功能不同的来改变身体吗？我们或许将变得不再完全相同。这样的未来难以把控，但也许对于我们整体的效率提高而言这是值得的。
entries.en: Our cybernetic research has produced multiple promising cyborg prototypes for our consideration. Preliminary results show that some prototypes excel at physical feats, while others are more suited for precision work. Each has its strengths and limitations, none showing clear superiority.\n\nA daunting proposal springs to our mind: Could we, perhaps, diversify our drones? Modify our bodies in different ways depending on their function? We won't be all identical anymore, a prospect we find hard to grasp. But the efficiency gain might make it worth our harmony.

entries.zh: 选择一种面面俱到的原型。
这也能是我们的一员吗？
在组装工蜂的过程中偶尔会有存在缺陷的躯体。通常这些畸形的工蜂都会被处理掉，但多亏了义体植入体，它们仍可以加入到我们的行列中。提高我们的数量是好事，但有缺陷的工蜂需要根据问题的严重程度进行个性化植入。我们的蜂巢会成长得更快，但也会变得更……不完美。
entries.en: Drone assembly occasionally results in defective bodies. Misshapen drones are usually disposed of, but thanks to cybernetic implants, they could be allowed to join our ranks. Improving our numbers is desirable, but faulty drones require personalized implants depending on the severity of their issues. Our Hive would grow faster, but also become more... imperfect.

entries.zh: 缺陷会让蜂巢陷入虚弱。
entries.en: An imperfect Hive is a weak Hive.

entries.zh: 一小部分受试对象遭受了对强化改造的不良反应。他们的身体排斥植入体，发生了危及生命的并发症。其病因似乎是一种以前未被注意到的遗传缺陷。根据初步计算，这大约会影响5%的工蜂人口。\n\n在确定了问题之后，我们现在可以对工蜂进行筛查加以预防，但不知道该如何处理受影响的人口。
entries.en: A small percentage of our test subjects are suffering adverse reactions to augmentation. Their bodies are rejecting the implants, bringing life-threatening side-effects. The cause seems to be a genetic defect, previously unnoticed. According to preliminary calculations, this affects around 5% of our drone population.\n\nHaving identified the issue, we can now screen our drones to prevent it, but we don't know what to do with the affected population.

entries.zh: 为有缺陷的工蜂安装有限的植入体。
entries.en: Equip defective drones with limited implants.

entries.zh: 我们的义体原型通过了批准，§Y$building_augmentation_center$§!也已经建好。我们的计划万事俱备，只剩下我们转化的后勤工作还没最终敲定下来。\n\n我们可以下令所有的工蜂前往$building_augmentation_center$以进行转化流程，暂停他们的日常活动。这个过程会非常快速，但期间会让所有的工厂都停止运转。或者我们还可以安排工蜂的日日构成，在他们的强制休息期间进行义体人转化，以避免影响日常活动。这种计划尽管慢了点儿，但影响也小一些。
entries.en: Our cyborg prototypes are approved. The §Y$building_augmentation_center$§! has been built. Our plan is ready, but the logistics of our transformation are yet to be finalized.\n\nWe could order all our drones to head to an $building_augmentation_center$ and undergo the procedure, suspending their daily activities. This process would be very fast, but would leave our factories empty until it is complete. Alternatively, we could work around our drones' schedules, turning them into cyborgs during their mandatory resting periods in order to not impact their activities. Although slower, this plan is less disruptive.

entries.zh: 强化改造速度取决于局势应对方案以及£building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center']建筑的数量。
entries.en: Augmentation speed depends on the situation approach and the number of £building£ ['building:building_augmentation_center'] buildings.

entries.zh: 由单一实体组成的帝国以怀疑的目光注视着我们，恐惧于我们的人口众多。而义体植入体可以让我们的特使具有更独特的面孔和个性，呈现出不那么同质的外表。\n\n这些分裂体的国家终将会感激我们的努力，甚至可能开始……同情我们，把我们看作他们的同类。
entries.en: Empires composed of singular entities watch us with suspicion, fearing our plurality. With cybernetic implants, we could give our envoys more distinct faces and personalities, presenting a less homogeneous facade.\n\nThe disunited would appreciate the effort. They might even start to... empathize with us. See us as one of them.

entries.zh: 提升非格式塔帝国对我们的评价。
entries.en: Increases the opinion of non-Gestalt empires towards us.

entries.zh: 让我们的特使更加地完全一致。
entries.en: Make our envoys even more unnervingly identical.

entries.zh: 降低非格式塔帝国对我们的评价。
entries.en: Lowers the opinion of non-Gestalt empires towards us.

entries.zh: 我们蜂巢的义体化正在顺利进行中。我们的一部分人口现在已经搭载了义体植入体，而另一部分则还是完全的生物体。我们从未体在自己的身体上验过这样强烈的差异。工蜂现在可以将自己识别为不同群体的一部分，这种分裂感正在诱发它们的个体意识。\n\n有些工蜂开始向自己身上安装小配件以装饰自己，或在植入体上绘制特殊符号以区分彼此。真是一种有趣但又令人担忧的发展。
entries.en: The cyberization of our Hive is continuing smoothly. Part of our population now carries cybernetic implants, while others are still completely biological. Never before have we experienced such striking differences between our selves. Drones are now able to identify themselves as part of one or the other group, and this split is expanding their sense of individuality.\n\nSome drones have started to adorn themselves with small accessories, or are painting symbols on their implants to tell each other apart. It's an intriguing, yet unnerving development.

entries.zh: 仅限领袖使用个人符号。
安装神经植入体对工蜂造成了意料外的影响：由于大脑变成了半义体，他们现在可以独立于我们的主意识之外产生个体意识。\n\n我们可以进一步开发这种科技，提升工蜂的自主思考能力。
entries.en: Installing neural implants into our drones led to an unforeseen result: since their brains are now partly cybernetic, they can now form individual thoughts separated from our main consciousness.\n\nWe could further develop this technology, improving our drones' capability for autonomous thinking.

entries.zh: 让我们的工蜂自己思考。
entries.en: Let our drones think for themselves.

entries.zh: 个体主义对我们的团结是一个威胁。
entries.en: Individuality is a threat to our unity.

entries.zh: 义体植入体让死亡这件事变得复杂了起来。\n\n将植入体从死亡的工蜂身上拆下可以让我们进行循环利用，减少浪费。我们的整个废弃物抛弃流程需要进行优化以兼容这一新的步骤；需要花费的资源较多。
entries.en: Cybernetic implants are complicating the logistic of death.\n\nStripping deceased drones of their implants would allow us to reuse the technology, reducing waste. Our whole waste disposal process would have to get an overhaul to accommodate this new step; the resource cost is significant.
Recycle the implants... and the bodies.

entries.zh: 我们现有的人口正在稳步地进行义体化，但必须为还未出生的人口建立一种流程。\n\n以我们的科技，我们甚至可以在[owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural]出生前就安装上义体植入体，从而创造一个真正义体化的物种：这种方案快速、轻松且高效。另一方面，初步研究表明，在极早期安装植入体可能造成精神分裂、精神错乱、震颤和各种发育障碍。
entries.en: Our existing population is undergoing cyberization at a steady rate, but we must establish a process for those yet to be born.\n\nWith our technology, we can fit our [owner.Species.GetSpawnNamePlural] with cybernetic implants before they are even born, creating a truly cybernetic species: a quick, easy and efficient solution. On the other hand, preliminary research show that installing implant at an early age early could cause dissociation, psychosis, tremors, and assorted developmental disorders.

entries.zh: 为义体化设立最低年龄限制。
entries.en: Establish a minimum age before cyberization.

entries.zh: 转化已经完成了。义体植入体经过了充分的测试、原型设计、优化、打磨并进行了安装，将我们的身体变为了完美的版本。
entries.en: The transformation is complete. Cybernetic implants have been tested, prototyped, refined, polished and installed, turning our bodies into perfected versions of themselves.

entries.zh: $cyber.2004.desc$\n\n我们的工蜂现在具有更强的个体思维能力——更多的自由也带来了新的可能性。
entries.en: $cyber.2004.desc$\n\nOur drones are now more capable of individual thoughts - and with greater freedom comes new possibilities.

entries.zh: $cyber.2004.desc$\n\n我们的工蜂比以往更加地团结了，金属的纽带强化了意识的联结。
entries.en: $cyber.2004.desc$\n\nOur drones are now more united than ever, metallic chains strengthening the bond of the mind.

entries.zh: $cyber.2004.desc$\n\n在这个过中，我们发现了改变的机遇。我们的团结中蕴含着力量，但更多的自主工蜂也带来了一定的优势。
entries.en: $cyber.2004.desc$\n\nDuring this process, we saw opportunities for change. There is strength in our union, but more autonomous drones also have their advantages.

entries.zh: 随着我们身体的演化，我们的蜂巢意识也可以发生蜕变。
entries.en: As our bodies evolve, so could our Hive Mind become something more.
There is no need to change.

entries.zh:
随着先进义体的出现，我们意识到自己的终极潜力。而到目前为止，我们还只触及了表面。

随着专业知识的积累和技术的进步，我们的社会必将发生变化。对智慧生命的完全整合我们势在必行。

抵抗毫无意义。全星系的心智都会是我们的。
entries.en:
With the advent of advanced cybernetics, we can realize our ultimate potential. Up to now, we have only scratched the surface.

As our expertise increases and technology improves, our society is sure to be transformed. The total assimilation of intelligent life is our destiny.

Resistance is meaningless. The minds of the galaxy are ours to employ.

entries.zh:
与机器融合后，我们的有机人口达到了近乎完美的状态。现在是时候将义体也整合进我们文明的织构之中了。

将同化人口的思维敏锐度进行简化，可以创造“聚合性记忆”，将他们的集体经验用来提升后勤能力。或者，我们可以通过促进“神经合唱”的创造，允许思想和情绪反应有更大的差异。

这两种情况都肯定会对我们的未来产生深远的影响。
entries.en:
Fused with the machine, our organic population has achieved a state of near perfection. The time has come to incorporate advanced cybernetics into the very fabric of our civilization.

By streamlining the mental acuity of our cyborgs, we could form an 'Memory in Aggregate', channeling their collected experience into increased logistical capacity. Alternatively, we could allow for greater variance in thought and emotional response by facilitating the creation of a 'Neural Chorus.'

Either course is sure to have a profound effect on our future.
